Title: Travel eSim Lead
Description:
Role Overview

The successful candidate will lead the Travel eSIM business end-to-end, developing and launching a competitive global Travel eSIM proposition targeting tourists, transit passengers and UAE-based international travellers.

The role combines commercial strategy, product development, digital customer experience, strategic partnerships and full P&L ownership, with responsibility for driving business growth and market competitiveness.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the Travel eSIM strategy, business case development, product design, launch and ongoing commercial growth.
* Own P&L performance, including revenue generation, margins, pricing strategy, customer acquisition and retention.
* Develop and optimise digital sales channels and customer journeys across e-commerce platforms, mobile applications, websites and WhatsApp.
* Establish and manage strategic partnerships with global eSIM providers, airlines, airports, travel companies and other distribution partners.
* Lead cross-functional teams across Product, IT, Digital, Marketing, Finance and Customer Care to ensure successful product delivery and operational excellence.
* Monitor global Travel eSIM competitors, market trends and customer insights to continuously enhance the product proposition.
* Identify new commercial opportunities, distribution channels and partnerships to expand market reach and profitability.

Candidate Requirements

* 10–15 years of relevant experience in telecommunications, digital products, international roaming, Travel eSIM, MVNO/MNO partnerships or consumer digital services.
* Strong understanding of the global Travel eSIM market and its competitive landscape, including providers.
* Proven experience launching, scaling and commercially managing digital products or propositions, with direct P&L ownership.
* Strong commercial negotiation, strategic partnership management and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
* Experience developing digital customer journeys, e-commerce platforms, customer acquisition strategies and conversion optimisation.
* Strong understanding of international connectivity, roaming propositions and global distribution models.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Telecommunications or a related discipline. An MBA would be advantageous.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A senior commercial or product leader currently working, at a telecom operator, global Travel eSIM provider or digital connectivity business.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience in Travel eSIM or international roaming propositions, with a strong track record of launching and growing commercially successful digital connectivity products.

Title: Information Security Program Manager
Description:
**Key Responsibilities**

 Plan, lead and manage the end-to-end ISO/IEC 27001 program, including ISMS scope definition, timelines, budget, resources and stakeholder reporting.

 Review existing information security policies, standards, procedures and records to assess completeness and alignment with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27002.

 Examine current security practices and controls across people, processes and technology to evaluate how effectively they operate in practice.

 Conduct a detailed gap analysis against ISO/IEC 27001 requirements (Clauses 4–10 and Annex A controls) and produce a prioritized remediation roadmap.

 Develop and maintain the information security risk management methodology, and conduct periodic technical risk assessments of applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud services and medical and clinical systems.

 Maintain the information security risk register and risk treatment plans, and track the implementation of treatments with risk and control owners.

 Coordinate periodic vulnerability assessments, penetration tests and configuration reviews, and ensure findings are risk-rated, remediated and verified.

 Establish and manage a CIS-based compliance program, adopting the CIS Critical Security Controls (v8) and CIS Benchmarks as secure configuration baselines for operating systems, databases, network devices, cloud platforms and applications.

 Conduct periodic CIS compliance assessments using automated scanning tools (e.g., CIS-CAT Pro, Tenable, Qualys), track compliance scores against agreed targets, and coordinate remediation or documented exceptions with system owners.

 Prepare and maintain the Statement of Applicability (SoA) and the documentation required for the ISMS, including the ISMS scope, policy, objectives and supporting procedures.

 Assess information security risks of third parties and suppliers, and ensure appropriate security requirements are included in contracts.

 Establish and run the ISMS internal audit program and management reviews, and track

non conformities and corrective actions through to closure.

 Prepare CLIENT for Stage 1 and Stage 2 re-certification audits and ongoing surveillance audits, coordinate with the certification body, and lead the response to any findings.

 Define information security KPIs and metrics, and generate and present periodic (monthly and quarterly) reports covering risk posture, control effectiveness, vulnerability and remediation status, CIS compliance scores, security incidents, audit findings and awareness completion, to support management reviews and decision-making.

 Drive information security awareness and training so that staff understand their responsibilities within the ISMS.

 Ensure the ISMS aligns with CLIENT policies and applicable UAE and Dubai Government information security and data protection requirements, including the UAE Information Assurance Standards, Dubai Electronic Security Center (DESC) requirements and healthcare data regulations.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

 Support the implementation, maintenance and certification of the IT Service Management System (ISO/IEC 20000-1) and the Business Continuity Management System (ISO 22301), working closely with the IT Service Management and Business Continuity teams.

 Align ISMS controls with ITSM processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, capacity, availability and supplier management.

 Contribute to business impact analysis (BIA), the definition of recovery objectives (RTO/RPO) and continuity risk assessments for critical IT services and information assets.

 Support the development, review and testing of IT service continuity, disaster recovery and business continuity plans, and ensure lessons learned are captured and acted upon.

 Identify opportunities for an integrated management system across ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including shared policies, documentation, internal audits and management reviews.

 Support internal and external audits for ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including evidence preparation and follow-up of corrective actions.

**Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.

 [7–10]+ years of experience in information security, including at least [3] years leading ISMS, security risk or compliance programs.

 Proven track record of leading at least one ISO/IEC 27001 implementation or certification.

 In-depth knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27002 and ISO/IEC 27005, and of risk

assessment methodologies.

 Hands-on experience implementing and assessing the CIS Critical Security Controls and CIS Benchmarks, including the use of configuration compliance scanning tools.

 Solid technical understanding of networks, operating systems, cloud platforms, identity and access management, and security technologies (e.g., firewalls, SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners).

 Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301; hands-on implementation or audit experience with these standards is a strong advantage.

 Familiarity with UAE and Dubai information security regulations and healthcare data protection requirements.

 Experience in healthcare or government environments is preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

 ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer and/or Lead Auditor

 CISSP, CISM or CISA

 ISO/IEC 20000-1 and/or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor (advantageous)

 CRISC or an equivalent risk management certification (advantageous)

 PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification

**Key Competencies**

 Program and change management

 Risk-based thinking and sound technical judgement

 Stakeholder management and ability to influence without direct authority

 Analytical thinking and attention to detail

 Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Arabic is an advantage)

 Facilitation, coaching and training delivery

Pay: AED22,000.00 - AED25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Senior Program Lead, Client Integration
Description:
G MASS Consulting are partnered with a leading global fund administration and alternative asset services provider, as they seek a Senior Program Lead to join their North American Client Integration team.

This is a senior delivery leadership role at a time of significant growth, leading the firm's most complex client integrations, conversions and strategic programs. The Program Lead will own large, multi-workstream onboardings for alternative investment managers end to end, working across Fund Accounting, Investor Services, Operations, Technology and Business Development. They will be a trusted, senior point of contact for clients' senior management throughout onboarding.

The client requires a strong, seasoned program or project manager from the fund administration or alternatives services provider space, who has repeatedly delivered complex client onboardings, conversions and transformation programs. They will understand target operating models and the impact of structural decisions, and be comfortable managing C-suite stakeholders. The successful candidate will be senior enough to engage clients and executives with credibility and steady a challenging program, while remaining hands-on, delivery-focused and able to make an immediate impact in a fast-paced environment.

The role is offered as an initial 12 month contract, with a strong opportunity to convert to a permanent position subject to performance and fit.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the firm's largest and most complex client integrations, conversions and strategic programs end to end, from scoping and planning through to go-live and transition to business as usual.
* Define program scope, governance, milestones and delivery plans, ensuring clear ownership and accountability across competing priorities and dependencies.
* Act as the senior point of contact for clients during onboarding, managing expectations and relationships with client senior management and third parties.
* Coordinate Fund Accounting, Investor Services, Operations, Technology, Legal and Business Development so that internal workflows meet each client's unique requirements.
* Support new business by participating in sales pitches, RFP/RFI responses and Proofs of Concept, and contribute to Administration Agreement (AA) and SLA negotiations.
* Identify and manage risks and issues on high-risk programs, escalating where required and recommending company-wide solutions.
* Produce high-quality status reporting and MIS for clients and the executive management team, with a strong emphasis on operational risk, escalation and complaints management.
* Direct virtual delivery teams, including AVPs and project managers, and manage pipeline, resourcing and work allocation across concurrent programs.
* Drive global best practice, standardisation and continuous improvement across the Client Integration function.

**Requirements**

* A strong, demonstrable track record of delivering large-scale client onboardings, fund launches or conversions as a program or project manager within a fund administrator, alternatives services provider or comparable investment operations environment, rather than a pure IT project management background.
* 7+ years in the financial services industry, including 5+ years of project or program management and 3+ years of client services within asset management.
* Solid knowledge of the alternatives fund lifecycle and the fund administration operating model, including fund accounting, investor services and middle office, and of how target operating model decisions affect clients and service delivery.
* Proven knowledge of Listed and OTC products, and genuine interest in the hedge fund and wider alternatives industry.
* Proven business analysis experience, with the ability to translate client requirements into workflows and delivery plans.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the credibility to engage client and internal stakeholders up to C-suite level, and to challenge where necessary.
* 3+ years of people and resource management experience, including leading and coaching virtual or matrixed delivery teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including preparation of status reporting and materials for executive audiences.
* Degree qualified or holding a related professional qualification; a formal project management qualification, accounting background or relationship management experience is advantageous.

**Benefits**

Length: Initial 12 month contract, with a strong opportunity to convert to a permanent position subject to performance

Office: Toronto, Halifax, Malvern (Pennsylvania), Miami, Dallas, Jersey City or New York (hybrid; 3-4 days on-site requirement); USA-wide candidates open to relocation considered

Title: Director of Retention Marketing
Description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.

We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**

Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**

We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

**Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Subscriptions and churn:** own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on-site and post-purchase offers), and report subscribers, MRR, churn and save rate by brand every week.
* **Email, SMS and lifecycle:** own email and SMS strategy, manage the retention agency, keep the calendar live and flows in testing, keep list health and deliverability strong, and plan sale and launch campaigns with the Head of Growth and the Head of Brand & Community.
* **Post-purchase experience and loyalty:** ship at least one post-purchase improvement every month, and use cancellation reasons, reviews, surveys and support contact reasons to find why customers leave and fix the cause with the owning team.
* **Customer experience and support:** lead the Customer Experience Manager, own the weekly CX KPI scorecard (CSAT, first response time, AI resolution rate, refund rate and chargebacks), set customer service policy, and grow 4- and 5-star reviews.
* **Retention data and reporting:** track cohort retention, repeat purchase rate and lifetime value by brand and channel, report retention KPIs weekly, run a monthly retention review with the CEO, and write the retention playbook as SOPs so it runs without one person.

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening Interview

(2) In-Depth Interview with our CEO

(3) Reference Calls

(4) Final Interview with our CEO

**Salary Expectation**

USD $115,000 to $145,000 a year (based on experience and expertise) + performance bonus of 15-20% of base after the trial period.

Title: Network Operations Center (NOC) Lead - Damascus Based
Description:
**Position Objective:**

Define and govern the NOC operating model, ensuring all front-office monitoring and L1 support functions across the fiber network, Core, IT (ITOC), and IXP domains are fully designed, staffed, tooled, and validated ahead of Day-1 launch. Post-launch, the role transitions to governing the MSP NOC function.

**Job Description & Responsibilities:**

Define the NOC operating model —structure, monitoring scope, support processes, shift model, and escalation matrix.

Define monitoring requirements — latency, jitter, packet loss, and availability thresholds triggering alarms, auto-tickets, and escalation.

Define fault management framework — alarm handling/correlation, fault classification, prioritization, ticket creation, TAC escalation, threshold requirements across all monitored domains.

Define the NOC interface to the change management process — planned maintenance visibility, change freeze enforcement, and network change impact monitoring.

Define NOC tooling requirements including OSS, NMS, EMS, monitoring platforms, and real-time dashboard specifications.

Define the interface model between the NOC, TAC, field teams, SecOC, Application Services, and MSPs.

Define NOC procedures for carrier peering and interconnection monitoring across international exchange points and subsea landing stations.

Define NOC KPIs, SLA requirements, and performance reporting framework.

Define staffing levels, skills requirements, and training framework for NOC operators across all domains.

Govern NOC readiness validation — oversee simulations, dry runs, and acceptance criteria sign-off.

Participate in cross-functional OAT (Operational Acceptance Testing) to validate end-to-end NOC readiness for Day-1 launch.

Define the IXP operating model — route server management procedures, peering policy governance, BGP fault handling, and member onboarding interface with the NOC.

**Qualifications & Experience**
:

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline.

Minimum 10 years in telecommunications network operations, with significant NOC leadership experience.

Strong experience designing or leading a NOC function in a carrier or wholesale infrastructure environment.

Experience defining alarm management frameworks and NOC tooling requirements across converged network and IT environments.

Greenfield or build-to-operate program experience is preferred.

Strong knowledge of NOC operations, monitoring methodologies, and alarm management across network and IT domains.

Experience with IXP operations including route server management, BGP monitoring, and peering policy governance.

Familiarity with NMS/EMS platforms, IT monitoring tools, and ITSM systems.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Strong written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

Experience with MSP governance, vendor performance management, and continual service improvement in NOC operations.

communication.

They want someone who understands enterprise networking, knows how to lead a technical team, can solve major problems, and can manage the overall network operation.

The role is technical with supervisory responsibilities.

:

Previous leadership experience of 2 or more years managing a team and Project Management experience in their background.

4 years of experience designing, implementing, and managing network infrastructure.

ServiceNow experience, it would be a huge plus if they had CISCO certs and ITIL.

Knowledge of networking infrastructure, architecture, security, and troubleshooting. (wifi, voice and security).

**Summary:**

Responsible for the Digital, Strategy, and Technology (DST) networking infrastructure and network operations, including enterprise/data center class WAN, LAN, and WLAN technologies. Supports and implements efforts to manage and improve the County's network infrastructure and operations (l&O) maturity through process improvement, automation, and implementing a business-centric approach to operations management. Oversees and supports network operations related to network services architecture, lifecycle management, security, disaster recovery, and capacity management working in coordination with other senior technology leaders. Supervises network operations activities to support reliable service delivery. Employment is subject to the terms, conditions, and policies detailed in the Personnel Policies Manual (PPM). This position requires regular in-person presence as an essential job function.

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities**

• Manages the daily activities, priorities, and workload of the Network Services Team responsible for enterprise routing and switching infrastructure, including WAN, LAN, and WLAN environments, as well as project-related work.

• Oversees network operations processes, including system management, event management, incident management, request fulfillment, problem management, change management, capacity management, configuration management, knowledge management, and service-level management, ensuring performance, availability, and capacity targets are met.

• Ensures reliable network operations by monitoring and managing performance, availability, and capacity while meeting established service level targets for uptime, latency, and incident response, and driving continuous improvement of network reliability.

• Serves as an escalation point for network-related incidents and outages, including after-hours support as required.

• Commits to and leads continual service improvement efforts in infrastructure and operations. Fosters a business-oriented culture and mindset driven by the opportunity to elevate the flow of value to the customer.

• Contributes to the development and leads the deployment of network-specific service strategies and the technical networking roadmap, in conjunction with enterprise-class network architectural standards, and ensures integration with DST strategic plans. Supports lifecycle management of network systems to ensure peak network performance and resiliency while maintaining vendor support, licensing requirements, and containing cost.

• Provides technical input and expertise in implementing large-scale system architectural design consistent with enterprise-class network architecture standards to ensure appropriate redundancy, fault tolerance, capacity planning, and product lifecycle support.

• Contributes to the planning and management of the County broadband infrastructure program and lease policy.

• Builds and maintains productive and effective relationships with other DST teams and stakeholders and through extreme cooperation develops a clear understanding of business needs. Responds with the agility required to address changing business priorities.

• Provides cost-effective delivery of DST services, assists in monitoring and managing operational costs of network operations, including annual operating and capital expenditure budgets, and demonstrates show back, ensuring consistency with the overall strategic objectives of DST.

• Participates in governance processes to ensure network services are delivered in alignment with agreed-upon service levels and business outcomes.

• Maintains competencies on new technologies and platforms and provides direction on what emerging technologies should be assimilated, integrated, and introduced in l&O to ensure that DST capabilities respond to the current and future needs of the business strategy.

• Provides leadership for the full life cycle of technical architecture, infrastructure engineering, infrastructure operations, and DST service support.

• Supports vendor and partner relationship management and contributes to sourcing strategies, ensuring alignment with service and operational requirements.

• Adopts new techniques and practices to support the continued maturity and improvement of infrastructure and operations capabilities.

• Designs, reviews, and ensures integrity of network system security in conjunction with the Information Security team as well as establishes disaster recovery processes, plans, and requirements.

• Ensures development and documentation of all networking standards, processes, runbooks, and procedures and communicates with County business units and departments as needed.

• Performs other duties as required.

Title: Director, Portfolio Management
Description:
**Location** Mississauga, Ontario, Canada **Job ID** R-264521 **Date posted** 16/11/2026

  

**WHY JOIN US?**

At AstraZeneca, we are dedicated to being a Great Place to Work, where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. With an ambitious goal of delivering 20 new medicines by 2030, there is no better place to make a difference in medicine, for patients, and in society.

Join us on this exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare. Our inclusive culture champions diversity and collaboration, and we are always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. As part of our team, you'll contribute to groundbreaking advancements that will shape a healthier future for people everywhere. Be a catalyst for change at AstraZeneca, where your work will have a real impact on improving people's lives.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to create a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by **engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week**. Our head office is purposely designed with collaboration in mind, providing space where teams can come together to strategize, brainstorm and connect on key projects.

**About AISI**

AstraZeneca AI for Science Innovation (AISI) is driving the convergence of artificial intelligence and life sciences at enterprise scale. AISI brings together data foundations, AI and machine-learning technology, strategic partnerships, process reinvention, and business-facing AI to accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery. Success depends on connecting and scaling existing capabilities, promoting reuse, and translating innovation into measurable scientific, patient, and enterprise value.

**The Opportunity**

The Director, Portfolio Management will lead the design, governance, and continuous improvement of AISI's portfolio management capability across strategic initiatives, AI and data platforms, external partnerships, projects, suppliers, managed services, and operational investments. The role ensures that strategy is translated into an executable portfolio, investments and resources are directed to the highest-value opportunities, delivery performance is transparent, and financial and operational risk, and compliance governance are embedded throughout the portfolio lifecycle.

Operating at the intersection of AISI leadership, scientific and therapeutic-area stakeholders, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, HR, and external partners, the Director will establish scalable ways of working, strengthen evidence-based decision-making, and deliver outcomes through cross-functional teams and managed-service providers. The role sits within AISI Operations and reports to the Head of AISI Operations.

**Scope and Core Accountabilities**

**Portfolio Strategy, Planning, and Governance**
------------------------------------------------

* Translate AISI strategy and scientific priorities into an integrated portfolio of investments, initiatives, platforms, products, partnerships, and operational services.
* Establish and continuously improve demand intake, assessment, value-based prioritization, funding, resource allocation, stage-gate review, delivery assurance, and benefits-realization processes.
* Maintain an integrated portfolio view, identifying opportunities to stop, sequence, accelerate, consolidate, reuse, or scale initiatives as priorities and evidence evolve.
* Lead portfolio governance forums and provide clear executive reporting on investment, demand, delivery health, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, capacity, financial performance, and expected value.
* Develop standardized dashboards and management information that enable timely, transparent, evidence-based decisions without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

**Financial and Investment Management**
---------------------------------------

* Partner with Finance and senior leaders to manage long-term investment planning, business cases, budgets, forecasts, and Run and Change expenditure.
* Oversee forecast-versus-budget analysis, variance management, accruals, cross-charges, resource recharges, purchase orders, and supplier-related financial commitments.
* Ensure financial information is accurate, timely, transparent, and connected to portfolio priorities, delivery milestones, and benefits realization.
* Define and track financial and non-financial value measures, including scientific impact, speed, adoption, reuse, risk reduction, productivity, and enterprise scalability.

**Operating Model and Process Excellence**
------------------------------------------

* Design and evolve the portfolio operating model, decision rights, governance forums, escalation pathways, and RACI frameworks required to manage a complex, global portfolio.
* Drive standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across portfolio, project, financial, supplier, contracting, resource, onboarding, and service-management processes.
* Introduce fit-for-purpose Agile, Lean Portfolio Management, Design Thinking, incremental delivery, and hybrid governance practices where appropriate.
* Ensure processes are practical, adopted, and supported by reliable data and fit-for-purpose tools, including ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, and portfolio or financial-management platforms.

**Partnership, Contracting, and Supplier Governance**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Provide end-to-end portfolio oversight of strategic alliances, AI and data partnerships, technology providers, suppliers, and managed services.
* Partner with Legal, Procurement, Finance, Privacy, Information Security, and technical leaders across the contracting lifecycle, from intake, due diligence, term-sheet development, and negotiation through execution, performance review, renewal, and exit.
* Implement supplier and partner governance through scorecards, service-level agreements, periodic business reviews, delivery-quality measures, commercial-health monitoring, risk mitigation, and value-for-money assessments.
* Ensure partner commitments, dependencies, milestones, financial obligations, and benefits are integrated into portfolio planning and reporting.

**Resource and Capacity Management**
------------------------------------

* Lead resource and capacity-management practices across projects, products, platforms, partnerships, and operational services.
* Oversee workforce planning, allocation, utilization, people recharges, onboarding, and prioritization of scarce scientific, AI, engineering, and portfolio-management capabilities.
* Work with functional leaders to identify capability gaps, resolve constraints, improve onboarding, and align internal and external capacity with strategic priorities.

**Risk, Compliance, and Delivery Assurance**
--------------------------------------------

* Establish portfolio-level approaches to risk, issue, dependency, assumption, and decision management, ensuring material concerns are identified early, escalated appropriately, and managed through resolution.
* Provide oversight of scope, schedule, cost, quality, benefits, adoption, operational readiness, and delivery performance across the portfolio.
* Ensure portfolio activities and external arrangements comply with relevant pharmaceutical and technology requirements, including data governance, GDPR and privacy, information security, intellectual property, procurement, ethical, quality, and regulatory frameworks.
* Anticipate and manage delivery underperformance, supplier failure, commercial disputes, IP complexity, changing priorities, financial pressure, data and technology dependencies, and regulatory constraints.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Change Enablement**
------------------------------------------------

* Build trusted relationships with AISI and Enterprise AI leaders, therapeutic and scientific areas, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, Legal, HR, Operations, and external partners.
* Facilitate alignment on priorities, investment choices, delivery expectations, trade-offs, and accountabilities across a global matrix organization.
* Communicate complex portfolio, financial, commercial, and delivery matters clearly to senior leaders and diverse stakeholder groups.
* Champion adoption of portfolio standards, transparent governance, and collaborative delivery while preserving the speed and experimentation required for AI innovation.

**Leadership**
--------------

* Lead and develop high-performing portfolio management, governance, and business-operations capabilities, directly and through matrix teams and managed-service providers.
* Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, continuous improvement, reuse, and measurable value delivery.
* Set clear standards and build scalable capabilities from the ground up, enabling consistent ways of working across functions and geographies.
* Contribute to AISI functional strategy and operating model evolution as the organization, technology landscape, and partnership ecosystem mature.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Essential**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, finance, life sciences, project management, law, data science, or a related discipline; a Master's degree or equivalent extensive professional experience is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience across portfolio management, program or project management, business operations, financial management, alliance or partnership management, supplier governance, contracting, or a related discipline in a complex global organization.
* Demonstrated experience leading portfolio management and process-transformation initiatives, including demand intake, value-based prioritization, governance, investment planning, resource allocation, delivery assurance, and benefits realization.
* Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, long-term planning, investment tracking, forecasting, budget management, accruals, variance analysis, cross-charges, purchase orders, and resource recharges.
* Experience managing suppliers, strategic partners, external collaborations, or managed services, including contracts, service levels, performance, commercial risk, value for money, and issue resolution.
* Experience designing and implementing operating models, decision rights, governance forums, processes, RACI frameworks, dashboards, and management information.
* Proven success influencing senior leaders and delivering through cross-functional teams, matrix structures, third parties, and managed-service providers.
* Ability to operate with limited direction in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and make sound decisions that balance scientific and strategic value, risk, cost, capacity, compliance, and delivery feasibility.
* Exceptional written, verbal, influencing, relationship management, and organizational skills.

**Desirable**
-------------

* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, life sciences, or another highly regulated technology environment.
* Working knowledge of AI and machine-learning ecosystems, data partnerships, cloud platforms, digital products, technology platforms, and platform-based delivery models.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical research and development and how AI, data, platforms, and external partnerships create scientific and competitive advantage.
* Experience establishing or scaling portfolio management, alliance management, PMO, or business-operations function.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, Waterfall, Design Thinking, or hybrid delivery approaches.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, and comparable portfolio, project, financial, procurement, or service-management tools.
* Knowledge of data governance, privacy, information security, intellectual property, quality, regulatory compliance, and IT risk management.
* Professional qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent portfolio, program, commercial, or supplier-management credentials.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* **Strategic thinking:** Connects scientific and enterprise strategy to investment choices, delivery priorities, and measurable value.
* **Enterprise perspective:** Optimizes across the portfolio, promotes reuse and scalability, and avoids isolated solutions.
* **Execution discipline:** Establishes clear governance and follows through to achieve reliable delivery and benefits realization.
* **Commercial and financial judgment:** Balances value, cost, risk, contractual obligations, compliance, and capacity.
* **Influence and collaboration:** Builds trust and alignment across scientific, technical, operational, legal, financial, and external stakeholder groups.
* **Architectural and operational thinking:** Designs scalable frameworks and makes them work in practice.
* **Change leadership:** Enables adoption of new processes, tools, governance models, and ways of working.
* **Entrepreneurial mindset:** Identifies opportunities, acts with appropriate autonomy, and creates pragmatic solutions in ambiguity.

**Measures of Success**

* A transparent, strategically aligned portfolio with clear ownership, decision rights, investment rationale, and measurable outcomes.
* Faster, higher-quality prioritization and governance decisions supported by reliable financial, delivery, risk, and value data.
* Improved delivery predictability, benefits realization, adoption, reuse, and scaling of AI and data capabilities.
* Strong partner and supplier performance, effective commercial stewardship, and proactive management of contractual and operational risk.
* Efficient resource deployment, improved capacity visibility, and disciplined financial management across the portfolio.

Lead data centre reviews covering physical and environmental security, power, cooling, fire protection, network redundancy, server and storage infrastructure, backup, capacity, availability, and single points of failure

Lead data protection, privacy, Microsoft Purview, AI governance, and emerging technology assessments, including reviews against ISO 42001 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework

Define engagement approaches, evidence requirements, testing methodologies, maturity-rating criteria, and reporting structures

Review working papers, technical assessments, observations, maturity ratings, risk conclusions, and client reports to ensure they are complete and evidence-based

Manage client workshops, status meetings, validation discussions, and presentations to senior technology, cyber, audit, risk, and business stakeholders

Supervise project teams, allocate technical workstreams, review deliverables, and provide technical guidance

Support technical proposals, scope development, effort estimation, and the development of new Technology and Cyber Advisory offerings

We take pride in attracting and retaining highly qualified faculty and administrative staff to ensure our school remains at the forefront of educational excellence. Join us in this transformative education journey, working together to empower young women to make a positive difference in our world.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that an inclusive environment fosters a culture of mutual respect, creativity and innovation, collaboration and accountability. To this end, we encourage applications from all qualified candidates with diverse experiences and perspectives, including women, BIPOC (Black, Indigenous and People of Colour) peoples, LGBTQ2S+, and persons with disabilities to join our thriving team. We seek candidates committed to nurturing a community where integrity, compassion, inquiry and courage thrive.

**The Position:**

The Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing provides operational leadership for student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12. Working collaboratively with the Upper School Leadership Team, this role ensures that every student is known, valued, and cared for, and has access to the relationships, resources, and support necessary to thrive academically, socially, and emotionally.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing oversees the integrated work of Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role. Through the leadership and development of these teams, the Assistant Head establishes a coordinated and responsive approach to student support that promotes belonging, engagement, inclusion and student success.

Guided by Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing, the Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing leads proactive and preventative approaches to wellbeing across the Upper School, building the capacity of faculty and staff to support students and ensuring effective systems are in place to identify and respond to emerging student needs.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing reports directly to the Head of Upper School and is accountable for fostering a safe, equitable and inclusive school culture aligned with Havergal's mission and values. This is a faculty leadership position requiring teaching qualifications and experience in an educational setting.

**Specific Accountabilities:**

**Leadership of Student Support & Wellbeing**

* Lead the development, implementation and ongoing evaluation of a comprehensive, coordinated approach to student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12, aligned with Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing.
* Champion proactive, preventative, strengths-based and evidence-informed approaches to wellbeing that promote student belonging, resilience, engagement and healthy development.
* Identify emerging trends in student wellbeing and learning needs, using relevant data, research and professional expertise to inform priorities, programming and resource allocation.
* Partner with the Assistant Heads of Middle and Senior Divisions and the Director of Boarding to ensure that wellbeing priorities are meaningfully embedded in the student experience, including Form, Teacher Advisor, grade-level and Boarding programming.
* Build faculty and staff capacity through professional learning and shared practices that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive education and effective responses to student needs.
* Contribute to school-wide strategic initiatives that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive excellence and the overall student experience.

**Leadership and Oversight of Student Support Services**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role.
* Lead, coach and develop Student Support leaders and team members, fostering professional growth, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities and communication practices across Student Support services to ensure an integrated and effective approach to student care.
* Oversee the effective allocation of staffing, resources and budgets across Student Support services.
* Ensure the effective delivery and continuous improvement of student support services, promoting responsive, accessible and coordinated support that meets the evolving needs of students and families.
* Provide leadership for Learning Support practices, ensuring effective systems for accommodations, Individual Education Plans and appropriate academic interventions.
* Champion the development of executive functioning skills, learning strategies and student self-advocacy in collaboration with academic leaders and faculty.
* Promote effective transitions for students entering, moving through and graduating from the Upper School, with particular attention to students requiring additional support.

**Coordinated Student Care and Intervention**

* Lead the development and implementation of effective systems for identifying, assessing, supporting and monitoring students experiencing academic, social, emotional, behavioural or health-related challenges.
* Oversee the Upper School Student Support Team, ensuring effective multidisciplinary collaboration, clear processes for case management and appropriate follow-through.
* Establish consistent protocols for student referrals, documentation, communication, intervention planning and escalation of concerns.
* Provide leadership and consultation in complex student support matters, working closely with Student Support professionals, divisional Assistant Heads and the Head of Upper School.
* Ensure that student support planning reflects appropriate professional expertise, confidentiality, safeguarding responsibilities and relevant school policies.
* Partner with families and external professionals, as appropriate, to coordinate student care and support successful school engagement.
* Oversee processes for student re-entry and reintegration following health-related leaves or other circumstances requiring coordinated support.

**Collaborative and Engaged Member of the Upper School Leadership Team**

* Serve as an active member of the Upper School Leadership Team, collaborating with divisional Assistant Heads, the Director of Boarding, Academic Leadership and Student Life leaders to advance shared priorities for student learning, wellbeing and engagement.
* Provide advice to the Head of Upper School on emerging student support needs, complex cases, resource priorities and opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to the ongoing review and development of relevant school policies, procedures, the Family Handbook and communications relating to student support and wellbeing.
* Support Admissions in reviewing prospective applicants with IEPs or social-emotional needs.

**Qualifications, Knowledge and Experience**

* A recognized teaching qualification and membership in good standing with the Ontario College of Teachers (OCT), or equivalent qualifications and eligibility for OCT certification.
* Demonstrated teaching experience in a school setting, preferably with students in Grades 7–12.
* Experience in educational leadership, student support, Guidance, Learning Support or a related area of school-based practice.
* Deep understanding of the developmental, academic, social and emotional needs of students in Grades 7–12.
* Demonstrated knowledge of contemporary approaches to student wellbeing, mental health promotion, inclusive education and coordinated student support.
* Familiarity with the priorities and contemporary approaches within a girls' school.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary teams and foster a collaborative, accountable team culture.
* Sound professional judgement, discretion and problem-solving ability, particularly in navigating complex and sensitive student and family matters.
* Strong understanding of safeguarding, confidentiality, professional boundaries and appropriate student support and intervention practices.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills, with the ability to build trusting relationships, think strategically and manage competing priorities.

Title: Executive Assistant to the Managing Director – Projects & Operations
Description:
**About the job**

We are looking for a highly capable, proactive and commercially aware Executive Assistant to the Managing Director who can do far more than traditional PA or administrative support. This is a role for someone who can take an idea, objective, event or project and make it happen. You will work closely with the Managing Director, helping turn priorities into action by researching, planning, coordinating, following up and ensuring projects are completed properly and on time. You will also play a key role in helping the Managing Director maintain oversight of the senior management team, ensuring priorities, calendars, projects, actions and deadlines remain visible, coordinated and on track.

**What the role involves**

-Supporting the Managing Director with priorities, planning, meetings and follow-up

-Taking ideas and turning them into clear actions, timelines and deliverables

-Coordinating projects from concept through to completion

-Organising events, exhibitions, launches, community initiatives, school visits and internal projects

-Liaising with staff, suppliers, partners and external organisations

-Tracking actions, deadlines and responsibilities across departments

-Following up proactively until tasks are completed

-Researching opportunities, suppliers, systems and solutions and presenting concise recommendations

-Preparing reports, presentations, proposals, trackers and management documents

-Supporting meeting preparation, documenting decisions and ensuring agreed actions are implemented

-Identifying problems early and helping resolve them before they escalate

-Managing confidential and sensitive information appropriately

-Acting as a reliable point of coordination between the Managing Director and the wider organisation

**Senior Management Team Coordination**

The Executive Assistant will support the Managing Director in maintaining visibility across the senior management team, which currently includes:

-Head of Administration & HR

-Head of Therapy Services

-Head of Digital Systems & IT

-Head of Marketing, Social Media & Public Relations

-Head of Inclusion

-Head of Psychology Services

The Executive Assistant will act as a central coordination point across these functions, helping ensure that agreed actions, deadlines and priorities are progressing and that the Managing Director remains informed.

**Management Team Coordination & Oversight**

-Overseeing and helping coordinate the Zoho calendars of key management team members

-Supporting managers with scheduling and workload organisation where required

-Maintaining visibility of important management tasks, projects and deadlines

-Regularly reviewing outstanding, approaching, overdue or blocked actions

-Following up with managers regarding agreed actions and completion dates

-Identifying delays, bottlenecks or dependencies between departments

-Keeping the Managing Director informed of progress, delays, risks and missed deadlines

-Helping ensure actions agreed in management meetings are clearly assigned and followed through

-Coordinating recurring management activities such as reviews, reporting deadlines, operational meetings and planning

-Helping maintain a clear overview of who is responsible for what and whether agreed actions are progressing

-Escalating matters appropriately where management input or intervention is required

The purpose of this responsibility is not to replace the authority or accountability of individual Heads of Department. It is to strengthen communication, coordination, follow-through and visibility so that the Managing Director can remain informed without personally chasing every action.

**Weekly Managing Director Overview**

The Executive Assistant will prepare a concise weekly management overview for the Managing Director, providing visibility of:

-Key priorities and activity across each management function

-Actions completed during the week

-Actions due in the coming week

-Overdue or delayed tasks

-Projects or tasks that are blocked or dependent on another department

-Decisions or approvals required from the Managing Director

-Emerging risks, operational concerns or deadlines requiring attention

**We are looking for someone who is:**

-Exceptionally organised and able to manage multiple priorities

-Proactive, resourceful and confident working independently

-Strong at project coordination and implementation

-Comfortable working from a broad idea rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions

-Excellent at following through and closing tasks

-Confident communicating with senior staff, suppliers and external stakeholders

-Able to professionally and confidently follow up with managers regarding actions and deadlines

-Able to identify when something is becoming delayed before it becomes a problem

-Calm under pressure and able to adapt quickly

-Commercially aware and mindful of time, cost and business impact

-Highly competent with digital systems, task-management platforms, shared drives and Microsoft Office

-Experienced with Zoho One, Zoho Calendar, Zoho Projects, Zoho Tasks or similar systems would be a strong advantage

-Excellent in spoken and written English

-Highly discreet and able to handle confidential management, HR and business information

**Ideal experience**

-Executive Assistant or senior PA roles

-Project coordination or project management

-Operations

-Management coordination

-Events and exhibitions

-Healthcare, education, therapy or child-related services

-Business support or management administration

**This is not a purely administrative PA role.**

We are looking for someone who can be given a direction such as: “We want to participate in this event.” …and independently work out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved, what the deadlines are, what needs to be ordered or prepared, what decisions are required and then drive the project through to completion. Equally, if a key management action is approaching its deadline, we want someone who will notice it, follow it up, understand whether anything is blocking progress and ensure the Managing Director is informed before it becomes an issue. The right person will help reduce the Managing Director’s workload by taking genuine ownership of coordination and delivery, improving visibility across the management team and helping ensure actions are followed through to completion.

**Role Details**

**Location:** Dubai, UAE

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Role:** Executive Assistant to the Managing Director – Projects & Operations

If you are someone who enjoys making things happen, solving problems, coordinating people and turning ideas into outcomes, we would like to hear from you.

Work Location: In person

Title: Night Duty Assistant Front Office Manager
Description:
Job Description – Night Duty Assistant Manager

Department: Front Office  
Reports To: Front Office Manager / Rooms Division Manager / Hotel Manager  
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Night Duty Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall hotel operations during the night shift, ensuring smooth and efficient service delivery, guest satisfaction, safety, security, and compliance with hotel standards and company policies.

The role serves as the senior management representative on duty during nighttime hours, handling guest concerns, managing operational issues, supervising night staff, and ensuring the hotel operates efficiently in the absence of daytime management.

Key Responsibilities1. Hotel Operations Management

* Ensure proper handover from the evening team to the morning team.
* Make operational decisions in the absence of senior management.

2. Guest Relations and Customer Service

* Welcome VIP guests and ensure special attention is provided where required.
* Handle guest complaints, requests, and service recovery professionally.
* Ensure high levels of guest satisfaction throughout the night.
* Follow up on unresolved guest issues and ensure appropriate corrective action.
* Maintain a visible management presence in the hotel.

3. Front Office and Night Audit

* Supervise night reception and front office activities.
* Ensure smooth check-in and check-out procedures.
* Monitor room availability, occupancy, room status, and arrivals.
* Ensure the night audit is completed accurately and on time.
* Review daily reports, financial transactions, and operational discrepancies.
* Ensure proper cash handling and compliance with financial procedures.
* Process Front Office Duty Roster and other Front Office related works

4. Security and Safety

* Ensure the safety and security of guests, employees, and hotel property.
* Conduct regular security and safety inspections.
* Monitor incidents, unusual activities, and emergency situations.
* Ensure compliance with fire safety, health and safety, and emergency procedures.
* Act as the incident coordinator during emergencies until the relevant senior management or emergency services take over.
* Complete incident reports and escalate serious matters immediately.

5. Team Management and Supervision

* Supervise and support all employees working during the night shift.
* Ensure adequate staffing and effective allocation of duties.
* Monitor employee attendance, grooming, conduct, and performance.
* Motivate team members and maintain a professional working environment.
* Address operational and staff-related issues appropriately.
* Ensure proper communication and handover between shifts.

6. Financial and Administrative Responsibilities

* Monitor overnight revenue and financial transactions.
* Ensure accurate completion of daily revenue and night audit reports.
* Investigate discrepancies and report irregularities.
* Ensure compliance with company financial controls and procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, guest complaints, and operational activities.

7. Reporting and Communication

* Prepare and submit the Night Manager's Daily Report.
* Communicate important operational updates to the Hotel Manager and relevant department heads.
* Highlight maintenance issues, guest concerns, security incidents, and outstanding matters.
* Ensure a detailed handover to the morning management team.

Qualifications and Experience

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in hospitality management, Hotel Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in hotel operations, preferably in a supervisory or management position.
* Previous experience as a Duty Manager, Night Manager, or Assistant Front Office Manager is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of front office operations, night audit, and hotel management systems.
* Knowledge of hotel health, safety, security, and emergency procedures.
* Experience in handling guest complaints and managing operational challenges.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Excellent guest relations and conflict-resolution skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
* Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and hotel PMS systems.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Night Duty Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Guest satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* Smooth and efficient overnight hotel operations.
* Accuracy and timely completion of night audit.
* Compliance with company policies and operational standards.
* Security, safety, and incident management.
* Staff supervision and performance.
* Quality of daily reports and shift handovers.
* Reduction of operational errors and financial discrepancies.

Authority and Accountability

The Night Duty Assistant Manager is authorized to:

* Make operational decisions during the night shift.
* Handle guest complaints and approve service recovery within company guidelines.
* Coordinate all departments and allocate available resources.
* Take immediate action in emergency situations.
* Escalate major financial, security, guest-related, or operational matters to senior management.

Overall Accountability: To ensure the hotel front office operates safely, efficiently, and professionally throughout the night, while maintaining the company's service standards, protecting its assets, and delivering an excellent guest experience.

Pay: AED2,500.00 - AED3,500.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: VP, Construction & ETO
Description:
**About Us**
Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. We're a proud Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner; Salesforce Crest Partner; Microsoft Gold Certified Partner, and much more: our evolution has taken us well beyond a single platform, making us a multi-technology advisory and implementation partner across ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, and AI-driven solutions. What sets us apart is a "technical-first" approach, teams who understand both business logic and deep system architecture paired with a genuine belief that our people are our greatest strength, and that's who we invest in first.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As Vice President, AI & Multitech, you'll position yourself and your team as the technology leaders clients turn to across Appficiency's full platform portfolio - spanning ERP, CRM, AI, and beyond. This is a role built for someone who thinks in ecosystems, not single platforms: you'll build and coach a team fluent across multiple technologies, shape long-term account strategy in step with our sales targets, and push AI-driven delivery efficiency to new heights. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales to shape regional strategy, ensuring the team you build reflects where the business is headed next.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own client health across the construction and ETO portfolio, building the kind of trust that keeps retention high in one of the firm's most demanding verticals
* Champion delivery excellence for construction and ETO engagements, ensuring every project lands within scope, on time, on budget, and to Appficiency's quality standard
* Cultivate deep, senior-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic construction and ETO accounts
* Take direct ownership of reducing escalations - since this industry generates a disproportionate share of the firm's escalations today, this is one of the clearest measures of your impact
* Partner with the product team to shape a stronger, more tailored customer experience for construction and ETO clients
* Build a delivery organization with genuine credibility in front of construction and ETO clients, coaching your internal team and hiring externally to bring in the industry expertise clients expect
* Act as a true partner to the SOS team, giving them the delivery support and credibility they need to win and grow construction and ETO business
* Turn strong delivery into growth, supporting the conversion of implementation engagements into follow-on opportunities and referenceable relationships
* Manage your portfolio's profitability with the same discipline you bring to client satisfaction and escalation management

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* A blend of backgrounds: hands-on experience in construction, civil engineering, or ETO manufacturing, paired with time spent inside an IT or software company - you've operated credibly in both worlds, and that combination is non-negotiable for this role
* A degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical field is strongly preferred; an MBA or equivalent business degree is a plus
* Working fluency in construction-specific business processes - job costing, percentage-of-completion accounting, change order management, RFIs, submittals, and subcontractor/vendor management — and how they translate into ERP and project system requirements
* Exposure to construction-focused ERP/field platforms (e.g., Procore, Viewpoint/Vista, Sage 300 CRE, CMiC, Foundation) is a strong plus, alongside broader ERP/CRM experience such as NetSuite or Salesforce
* 10+ years in Professional Services or construction/ETO industry leadership, with 7-8 of those years in systems implementation, integration, or process re-engineering for construction or engineering-driven organizations
* A track record of managing distributed delivery teams across multiple regions on concurrent, complex projects
* Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including genuine fluency in reading and acting on job-cost reporting and P&L
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for site visits and client needs

What Will Set You Apart
  
  

* A rare blend of construction industry experience and enterprise technology delivery background - you've credibly operated in both worlds, not just one
* A track record of reducing escalations and stabilizing delivery in complex, industry-specific engagements
* Strong executive presence with construction and ETO clients who expect a partner who understands their business, not just their software
* Experience partnering with product and sales teams to shape offerings and win business in a specialized vertical
* A reputation in the industry that opens doors - clients and prospects recognize your name before you walk into the room

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Escalations originating from construction and ETO accounts trend consistently downward under your leadership
* Your portfolio's false-start and early-termination rate holds well below the firm's threshold
* Clients recognize your delivery team as genuine construction and ETO experts, not generalists applying a standard playbook
* Sales consistently reports strong, proactive support from Delivery on construction and ETO opportunities, and the partnership shows up in win rates
* Your product feedback loop measurably improves the customer experience for construction and ETO clients over time

Title: Gestionnaire principal, gestion de programmes, Construction de centres de données
Description:
**Req Id:**
433116
  
  
Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**Résumé**
**Programme IA Fabric de Bell**
est une initiative de transformation visant à déployer une infrastructure de centres de données évolutive et essentielle aux opérations. Le
**gestionnaire, contrôle de programme**
sera responsable d’établir et de maintenir les processus de gouvernance qui assurent la coordination entre les différents services, projets et parties prenantes du programme.
  
  
Relevant du ou de la
**directeur, contrôle de programme**
, cette personne fournira un leadership dans les domaines suivants : la gestion des interfaces et des transferts, la gouvernance des risques, l’analyse des causes fondamentales, la capitalisation des leçons apprises, l’amélioration continue, la gestion des mesures de suivi ainsi que la coordination du contrôle des changements.
  
  
Le titulaire du poste contribuera à maintenir une vision intégrée et fiable des risques, des dépendances, des actions et des initiatives d’amélioration du programme afin de soutenir une exécution prévisible et efficace des projets.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**
**Gestion des interfaces et des transferts**

* Administrer le registre des transferts et interdépendances du programme.
* Coordonner les revues interfonctionnelles entre les équipes de développement, d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement, de construction, de mise en service, d’exploitation, de sécurité, des TI et les parties prenantes réglementaires.
* Surveiller les dépendances, les critères d’entrée et de sortie ainsi que les exigences de transfert à chaque phase du projet.
* Identifier et signaler les enjeux liés aux dépendances, aux livrables, aux responsabilités et aux étapes critiques.

**Gestion des risques et analyse des causes fondamentales**

* Maintenir le registre RAID du programme et soutenir les processus de gouvernance des risques.
* Coordonner les revues de risques, le suivi des mesures d’atténuation et les actions correctives.
* Diriger ou faciliter les analyses des causes fondamentales pour les enjeux majeurs ayant un impact sur les coûts, les échéanciers ou la performance.
* Analyser les tendances et recommander des mesures préventives ou correctives.

**Leçons apprises et amélioration continue**

* Développer et maintenir un cadre structuré de leçons apprises.
* Recueillir et intégrer les apprentissages aux principaux jalons du programme.
* Traduire les leçons retenues en améliorations des procédures, normes, outils et pratiques de livraison.
* Animer des ateliers et revues visant l’amélioration continue et l’efficacité des contrôles.

**Gestion des actions et gouvernance**

* Mettre en place un processus de suivi des actions à boucle fermée.
* Veiller à ce que les actions, risques, décisions et initiatives d’amélioration soient assignés, suivis et clôturés adéquatement.
* Assurer des suivis réguliers et fournir à la direction une visibilité sur les enjeux, retards et décisions requises.

**Gestion du changement**

* Coordonner le processus de contrôle des changements et les évaluations d’impact.
* Assurer l’alignement des changements avec les risques, les dépendances, les transferts et les références du programme.
* Maintenir des registres, journaux de décisions et rapports de gouvernance vérifiables.

**Rapports et soutien au contrôle de programme**

* Produire des tableaux de bord et rapports exécutifs sur les risques, les interfaces, les actions, les changements et les initiatives d’amélioration.
* Soutenir les cycles de gouvernance et de reddition de comptes du programme.
* Fournir des analyses sur les tendances, les dépendances et les risques émergents.
* Contribuer à la mise en œuvre et à l’amélioration continue des processus, outils, normes et pratiques de contrôle de programme.
* Agir comme point central d’intégration de l’information tout en assurant l’imputabilité des équipes responsables de la livraison.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* Expérience progressive en contrôle de programme, contrôle de projet, gestion de bureau de projets (PMO), gestion des risques, gouvernance de programme, amélioration continue ou réalisation de grands projets d’investissement (CAPEX).
* Expérience démontrée dans la coordination de programmes ou de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires impliquant plusieurs équipes internes, consultants, entrepreneurs et fournisseurs.
* Solide compréhension des pratiques de gestion des risques, des enjeux, des mesures correctives, des changements, des interfaces et de la gouvernance.
* Expérience dans l’animation d’analyses des causes profondes (Root Cause Analysis) et dans la mise en œuvre et le suivi d’actions correctives jusqu’à leur résolution.
* Capacité à intégrer les données liées aux échéanciers, aux coûts, aux risques, aux changements et au transfert des livrables afin d’offrir une vision globale et intégrée du programme.
* Excellentes compétences analytiques, organisationnelles, d’animation et de gestion des parties prenantes.
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des informations complexes et à produire des rapports concis destinés à la haute direction.
* Maîtrise des outils Microsoft 365 et bonne connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de projets et de production de rapports.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience dans le soutien à la réalisation de projets de centres de données, d’infrastructures critiques (mission-critical), de télécommunications ou d’infrastructures hyperscale.
* Connaissance du cycle de vie des centres de données, incluant la planification, la conception, l’approvisionnement, la construction, la mise en service (commissioning), la préparation opérationnelle et le transfert aux équipes d’exploitation.
* Connaissance des environnements critiques liés aux systèmes électriques, mécaniques, de refroidissement, d’automatisation et contrôle, de réseaux et de sécurité.
* Expérience avec les outils Primavera P6, Power BI, EcoSys, Procore, SAP, SharePoint ou d’autres plateformes similaires de contrôle de projets.
* Certification professionnelle PMP (Project Management Professional), PMI-RMP (PMI Risk Management Professional), PSP (Planning & Scheduling Professional), CCP (Certified Cost Professional), Lean Six Sigma ou certification équivalente

**Exigences supplémentaires**

* Leadership transversal et capacité à influencer et mobiliser les parties prenantes sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
* Excellentes aptitudes en résolution structurée de problèmes et solide jugement professionnel.
* Sens des responsabilités, rigueur dans le suivi des dossiers et grande attention aux détails.
* Capacité à remettre en question de façon constructive, à formuler des recommandations pertinentes et à escalader les enjeux avec clarté lorsque nécessaire.
* Excellentes habiletés de communication avec la haute direction et capacité à présenter des analyses et recommandations fondées sur les données.
* Mentalité d’amélioration continue et engagement envers l’apprentissage organisationnel et le partage des meilleures pratiques.
