Title: Construction Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 23,500 employees operate across over 70 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

 **Job Description**

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Coordinates and supervises the construction process from the conceptual development stage through final construction, making sure that the project is completed on time.
* Evaluates and helps determine appropriate construction delivery systems and the most cost-effective plan and schedule for completing the project
* Oversees the performance of all trade contractors and is responsible for ensuring that all work is completed on schedule.
* Direct the work for Sr. Architectural, Electrical, Structural & Mechanical and other sub-ordinates, in arranging review of shop drawings, method statements, material and site inspections, as-built drawings, O & M Manuals, warranties, etc.,
* Monitoring suitability and availability of drawings and other data to ensure the contractor has the right information for the work in hand.
* Monitoring the quality and timeliness of inspections carried out by the consultant.
* Monitoring contractors for compliance with their contractual responsibilities.
* Monitoring progress of the works for compliance with schedule.
* Ensuring that appropriate planning tools are implemented by the contractor, including accurate look ahead schedules.
* Ensuring that materials for the works are submitted for approval in time, delivered on time and suitably stored on site prior to incorporation in the works.
* Ensuring that client furnished materials are requested in sufficient time to permit purchase and deliver to site without delay to the schedule.
* Ensuring that each contractor complies with the current coordinated method statement for coordinating with other contractors.
* Monitoring contractor’s compliance with security requirements.
* Immediate reporting of any infraction or occurrence that constitutes a serious infraction or emergency.
* Ensuring issues related to projects are properly entered into the issue logs and are then addressed and resolved in an appropriate fashion.
* Recommending approvals / disapproval of variation orders/claims.
* Establishing and maintaining the procedures for meetings, meeting documentation, follow up and tracking of issues and participate actively in resolving outstanding issues.

* Identifying and minimizing the risks of potential claims
* Reviewing, analyzing and preparing recommended actions for disputes and claims
* Preparing documentation for all occurrences in the field on a daily basis.
* Coordinating claim mitigation, contract interpretation and cost analysis for submitted claims and maintaining all relevant documentation.
* Reviewing contractor submitted resumes and plans for contract compliance.
* Coordinating and managing pre-bid activities including meetings, addenda, answers to bidder questions and bid evaluation.

Bachelor's in engineering degree

MMUP Certified

10-14 years of technical experience

7-9 years of management experience

other professional accreditation certificates

* Strong analytical, business-case development and presentation skills
* Strong partnership development and stakeholder management skills

Title: Senior Construction Manager (Infra & Landscape) - Saudi National
Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director
Description:
**Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director - Digital Project Delivery**

**(This role can be based in any global Worley office)**

**About Worley**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets.

With more than 40,000 employees in over 40 countries, we specialise in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**The role**

Shape how the world's energy, chemicals and resources projects are built and brought to life. As our Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director, you'll lead the team that digitally enables successful Construction and Commissioning (C&C) delivery across Worley's global project portfolio.

**Why this role matters**

At Worley, digital enablement spans the full stack of people, process and technology a global EPC company needs. Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Project Delivery (DPD) and joining the DPD leadership team, you'll set the direction for C&C digitalisation and have the authority and autonomy to make it happen. You will own the strategy, technology and corresponding processes that help our project teams deliver better outcomes for our customers.

DPD is part of Digital Operations at Worley and exists to support Operations, so your work in this global role will have impact across the organisation.

This is where deep digital expertise meets senior leadership. Rather than writing code yourself, you'll set the technical direction and lead a talented team across multiple locations, bringing them together to turn that vision into results on our projects. You'll engage with functional representatives in Operations to ensure C&C project needs are understood and delivered.

Worley has placed Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) at the centre of project execution. A key part of this role is supporting the seamless digital enablement of AWP on projects. AI is also central to our digital strategy, and this role will help shape how we adopt AI across C&C delivery.

**What you will do**

* Set the strategy: Define the strategy for digital enablement of C&C as part of the wider DPD strategy, build the plans to deliver it, and develop strategic relationships with external technology partners that support our DPD ambition.
* Own the solution: Take ownership of the C&C technology stack, including tools, integrations, automation, AI, data management and reporting, across its full build-operate-support-retire lifecycle, partnering closely with other parts of the Worley digital team.
* Own the approach: Define the end-to-end C&C workflow for digitally enabled projects in collaboration with the project delivery function.
* Lead implementation: Drive adoption of the C&C digital way of working, collaborating with the DPD People and Processes team to ensure a consistent approach across project delivery.
* Enable our people: Contribute to organisational change management, define the digital competency requirements for project personnel, and support the governance framework that embeds the Worley digital approach.
* Deliver standout support: Build a support culture focused on keeping our people productive, using service metrics to drive continuous improvement.
* Lead and grow the team: Manage geographically dispersed direct and indirect reports, including subcontractors, and develop and manage the team budget in line with company delegation of authority requirements.

**What you will bring**

* Demonstrated experience in construction and commissioning.
* Strong digital execution expertise and AI capability.
* A proven record of directly leading and managing teams.
* A relevant university degree.
* Experience collaborating across teams to deliver practical solutions.
* Experience developing strategies, operating models and frameworks, with a track record of successfully implementing new ways of working.
* Experience with digital solutions on projects and awareness of software commonly used for C&C delivery. Knowledge of O3 is preferred.
* Thought leadership, with the ability to move between strategic and tactical thinking and work comfortably with new concepts and complexity.
* Strong relationship and influencing skills across all levels, cultures and external parties, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and facilitate discussions with large groups.

**What's in it for you**

* A senior leadership role on the DPD leadership team, with genuine authority and autonomy over C&C digitalisation.
* The opportunity to shape how digital technology is used to build and commission projects globally.
* The opportunity to build capability in deploying digital solutions across a large multinational organisation.
* Latitude to explore emerging C&C digital technologies with technology providers that could shape the future of project delivery at Worley.

***\*Applicants must possess valid working rights for the country in which the role will be based.***

Title: Global Customer Service Manager
Description:

Founded in 2021, Matrix Adhesives Group is a growth-driven company committed to delivering high-performance bonding and sealing solutions across diverse industries. Matrix Adhesives Group is more than a supplier. We are your collaborative partner backed by a powerhouse of leading brands - committed to performance, innovation, and long-term value.
  
  
For more information visit https://www.matrixadhesives.com/.
  
  
**About The Role**
This position leads the customer service team to deliver excellence in our customer experience.
  
  
It is both a manager role as well as a do-er role:
  
  

* Manages the global team of Customer service representatives: team representation and people management including goal setting, performance management, personal development plans, department strategy and continuous improvement plan
* Represents the company in front of the customer and as such both support the commercial strategy implementation as well as get and communicate customer needs and feedback to internal functions as needed.
* Executes general customer support duties, handling incoming orders, customer inquiries related to pricing, current orders and order status, lot numbers, shipping and quality issues. The work involves the execution of specific instructions and procedures in the ERP system or in Salesforce, and typically comprises order processing, order acknowledgement, and shipping confirmation. The position requires continual, proactive communication and coordination with customers, sales, production/scheduling and Quality Control departments.
* Acts as main focal point for positive customer experience through: Promptness, Politeness, Professionalism and Personalization. The quality of work and customer service affects the quality, internal and external customer satisfaction, and on-time delivery.

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
*****Team Management*****

* Represent the team in the commercial management team, as well as in the global customer service team. Bring the voice of the customer in the wider organization, including by active participation to the daily management walk in the plant (managing customer service metrics)
* Manage local and remote staff: goal setting, performance management, personal development plans, daily coaching and support, etc.
* Follow all safety guidelines for a safe work environment. Report any unsafe working conditions or behaviors to the appropriate safety manager and/or supervisor
* Prepare sales and usage reports for customers, as needed by the commercial team.

At **The St. Regis Doha**, we are more than a luxury hotel; we are a brand defined by bespoke service, timeless elegance, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. Inspired by the legacy of St. Regis, we create unforgettable experiences through personalized service that anticipates the needs of every guest. We are seeking a passionate and people-focused **Human Resources Manager** who will play a key role in attracting, developing, and engaging talent while fostering a culture that reflects our values and elevates the associate experience.

**JOB SUMMARY**

As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

**Preferred Qualifications & Attributes**

* Proven Human Resources leadership experience within a luxury hospitality environment
* Strong working knowledge of Qatar Labour Law and local employment regulations
* Ability to act as a strategic business partner, influencing stakeholders and driving people-focused initiatives across the hotel

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**

* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.
* Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.
* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.
* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.
* Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process.
* Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures.
* Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.
* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

**Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**

* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.
* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.
* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.
* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.

**Managing Employee Development**

* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
* Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.
* Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.
* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs
* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

**Maintaining Employee Relations**

* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).
* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.
* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner
* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources.
* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.
* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**

* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.
* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.
* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.
* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).
* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.
* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.
* Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.
* Represents Human Resources at the property Safety Committee; helps to identify ways to create awareness of the importance of safety in the workplace and decrease accident frequency and severity.
* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.
* Oversees the selection/non-selection and offers processes to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non-selection and applicants receive status notifications).

---------------

Re-imagine advertising with Amazon. Amazon Ads offers a rich array of digital advertising solutions with the goal of helping our customers find and discover anything they want to buy. We help advertisers reach Amazon customers on Amazon owned and operated sites and on other high quality sites across the web. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising product with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.  
  
A strategically important part of our charter is to drive adoption across a portfolio of self-service, cost per click advertising products to enable head to tail advertisers to engage with customers in relevant ways. Our team is tasked with making it easy for prospective and current advertisers to increase visibility of their products and services, which also helps Amazon customers discover more selection—a win-win!  
  
Within our growing Amazon Ads Marketing organization, we are seeking an experienced Sr Marketing Manager to join our Global Small Business (SMB) Americas team. This leader is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing 3P Canada Store partnership strategies that work backwards from the needs of SMB customers and drive consideration of our advertising solutions and supporting programs. The Sr. Manager will accomplish this by deeply understanding our product portfolio, develop comprehensive marketing strategies, and deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns to support their vision. The right candidate will be collaborative, results oriented, relentlessly focused on the customer, has the ability to make trade-offs, and executes with high standards. They will be passionate about owning a new initiative and able to manage stakeholder feedback, develop goals based on inputs, and track success by standing up mechanisms and creating metrics. The Sr. Marketing Manager will report out on program health regularly to key stakeholders and partner teams across the Amazon Ads organization.  
  
This is a cross-functional role that requires close partnership across 3P Store, Product Marketing, Ad Product and Tech, and Legal/PR. Success in this role requires having a passion for SMBs, as well as a strong backbone, great communication skills, both verbal and written, and the ability to deal with a significant amount of ambiguity.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Responsible for 3P Canada Stores' campaign strategies that articulate insights, and provide measurable creative and business content strategies
* Lead campaign framework development to inform 3P channel strategies, analytics and measuring success, and educatainment strategies for tent pole initiatives
* Responsible for execution and implementation of marketing strategies that support the SMB marketing work with 3P stores
* Connect the dots between business goals, customer insights, marketing strategies, and creative development

* Identify novel customer insights and brand opportunities to drive consistent, high-bar creative which positively shift perceptions and grows our business
* Manage multiple priorities and make things happen in a fast-paced, dynamic, culture.
* Collaborate and build relationships with marketing stakeholders across Amazon Ads

* Present solutions and gracefully defend decisions to executive management
* Responsible for the development of annual strategic planning such as OP1, OP2 and brand GTM plans

The SMB (Small and Medium Businesses) marketing team serves sales unmanaged advertisers globally. Our mission is twofold: 1) Grow Amazon Ads awareness & consideration amongst SMBs globally 2) Drive Sponsored Ads demand for the self service (SSO) channel.

------------------------

* 8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience

They manage a team of Category Managers, Sourcing Specialists, Senior Buyers, and Buyers to ensure that high-value, complex sourcing events and day-to-day purchasing are executed in a timely, compliant, and cost-effective manner. The Senior Manager, Procurement is accountable for following all process and policy guidelines throughout the sourcing process and collaborate closely with divisional heads to ensure business needs are being managed proactively and efficiently.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
**Strategy and Planning:**  

* Oversee multi-year category planning and procurement pipeline development led by Category Managers, ensuring alignment with divisional needs and contract expiry timelines.
* Review category and sourcing strategies, demand forecasts, and category roadmaps to validate priorities and closely manage high-risk/high-impact initiatives.
* Monitor request volume and trends across strategic and transactional procurement intake to inform resource planning, role delegation, and process improvements.

* Support division facing conversations in non-routine cases, acting as a senior point of contact for escalations, complex requests or clarifications.
* Oversee coordination with Legal, Contract and Vendor Management teams to support negotiations, contract hand offs and integration of vendor insights.
* Collaborate with the Centre of Excellence to refine sourcing templates, procurement protocols/policies, and intake tools, as needed.
* Represent the procurement function in cross-functional leadership discussions, strategic planning sessions, and major project reviews.

**Performance Management and Continuous Improvement:**  

* Monitor team performance, workload distribution, and compliance using reports from the analytics team; address bottlenecks or gaps in process.
* Oversee and monitor systemic risks in sourcing or purchasing and lead the implementation of mitigation strategies.
* Facilitate staff development, onboarding, and cross-training to build procurement capacity and improve service delivery, with support from the Centre of Excellence.

* Advanced public procurement training or experience with a focus on category management and strategic sourcing
* Minimum 7 years (10+ years preferred) strategic sourcing procurement in a large/complex environment preferably in the facilities maintenance and construction industry with majority of the experience

Title: Senior Manager, Strategic Property & Development Partnerships
Description:
Calix is seeking an established property ecosystem and strategic partnerships leader to develop and manage relationships with organizations that own, develop, operate, manage, build, renovate, and influence technology deployment within the Managed Business ecosystem.  
Reporting to the Area Vice President, Managed Services Ecosystem & Partner Programs, the Senior Manager, Strategic Property & Development Partnerships will own the Property & Development Ecosystem across four strategic customer segments: Multifamily / MDU, Hospitality, Student Housing, and Venues.  
The successful candidate will bring substantial expertise and active executive and operational relationships within at least one target segment, demonstrated familiarity with adjacent segments, and the ability to identify the organizations that exert the greatest influence over property development, capital planning, operating standards, procurement, technology selection, deployment, and managed-service adoption. This is not a role in which the core market network and domain expertise will be developed after joining Calix.  
The role will identify, prioritize, recruit, and manage the property and development organizations most important to Calix's Managed Business strategy. The role will translate these relationships into market insight, Product Group requirements, segment priorities, and repeatable opportunities for MSP and related channel partners. The role will also collaborate with Marketing on segment positioning, market activation, executive engagement, and ecosystem programs.

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

**Property & Development Partner Strategy**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain a prioritized partner strategy for each target customer segment.
* Apply existing market knowledge and relationships to identify the organizations and decision-makers with the greatest strategic relevance to Calix.
* Evaluate prospective partners using criteria such as property or venue footprint, development and renovation pipeline, operating influence, technology authority, market access, channel fit, strategic alignment, and ability to scale.
* Recommend where Calix should invest, where Calix should monitor, and where Calix should not pursue a relationship.
* Build segment-level ecosystem maps, partner portfolios, engagement plans, and relationship roadmaps.
* Continuously assess ownership trends, acquisition and redevelopment activity, operator shifts, consolidation, capital plans, procurement practices, and emerging market participants.

**Strategic Partner Development & Management**
----------------------------------------------

* Use an established network to open and accelerate relationships with senior leaders, operating executives, development leaders, technology decision-makers, procurement stakeholders, and design-build participants at priority organizations.
* Recruit, develop, and manage selected organizations within the Property & Development Ecosystem across the four customer segments.
* Establish shared objectives, executive sponsorship, operating cadences, mutual commitments, and measurable success criteria with priority partners.
* Coordinate relationship activity across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Sales, Operations, Legal, and technical stakeholders.
* Develop opportunities for market development, solution validation, design influence, joint education, reference architectures, property pilots, executive engagement, and other mutually beneficial initiatives.
* Maintain an accurate view of partner strategy, organizational dynamics, development and operating priorities, decision processes, and relationship health.

**MSP Route-to-Market Activation**
----------------------------------

* Partner with the MSP ecosystem team, Sales, and Business Development to convert property and development relationships into qualified, scalable opportunities for MSPs and related channel partners.
* Define clear engagement models, account roles, ownership boundaries, mutual value, and handoff processes among Calix, property ecosystem partners, and service-delivery partners.
* Identify repeatable demand-generation and deployment patterns that can be operationalized through MSP specializations, enablement, solution plays, and partner programs.
* Ensure that ecosystem activity supports an indirect route to market rather than creating an uncoordinated direct-sales motion.

**Product Group Collaboration**
-------------------------------

* Serve as the primary ecosystem advisor to the Product Group for property, development, ownership, operating, and design-build organizations across the target segments.
* Bring informed owner, developer, operator, management, construction, deployment, and lifecycle requirements into solution planning.
* Help Product Group teams understand segment-specific workflows, property or venue operating realities, procurement models, installation constraints, capital cycles, and lifecycle requirements.
* Connect Product Group leaders with the right business, operations, development, technology, and deployment stakeholders at priority organizations.
* Coordinate discovery sessions, advisory discussions, solution validation, pilot opportunities, and launch-readiness input as appropriate.
* Provide candid recommendations when proposed solutions, partnerships, or segment assumptions do not align with market realities.

**Marketing & Segment Strategy Collaboration**
----------------------------------------------

* Collaborate with Marketing on segment strategy for MDU, Hospitality, Student Housing, and Venues.
* Contribute ecosystem intelligence to segment positioning, value propositions, messaging, content, campaigns, events, and thought leadership.
* Identify opportunities for partner stories, executive forums, relevant conferences, webinars, advisory councils, and market education.
* Help Marketing distinguish the ownership structures, operating models, buying processes, development cycles, capital plans, and influence patterns unique to each segment.
* Provide ongoing insight regarding investment activity, development and renovation trends, customer priorities, competitive moves, and partner-enabled routes to market.
* Use associations, conferences, and executive forums as channels for relationship development and market activation; this role does not own Calix's broader industry-organization or standards-body partnerships.

**Target Ecosystem Expertise**
==============================

Candidates should bring deep expertise and active relationships in at least one target segment, demonstrated familiarity with a second, and the ability to apply a common property-development and operating framework across all four segments.

**Multifamily / MDU**
---------------------

* Multifamily, planned-community, and build-to-rent developers, owners, operators, and property management organizations.
* Construction companies, general contractors, installation partners, low-voltage contractors, and smart-home integrators.
* Organizations responsible for property technology standards, deployment decisions, resident experience, capital planning, and building operations.
* Knowledge of how ownership, development, acquisition, redevelopment, property management, and construction stakeholders influence connectivity and managed-service decisions.

**Hospitality**
---------------

* Hotel brands and flags, including organizations such as Marriott, Hilton, IHG, and comparable companies that set technology standards or mandates.
* Hotel owners, ownership groups, and REITs, including organizations comparable to Host Hotels and Summit.
* Hotel management companies and operators, including organizations such as Aimbridge, Highgate, and comparable companies that operate properties and engage service providers.
* Hospitality developers, design-build participants, guest internet providers, in-room technology integrators, and organizations that influence new builds, renovations, property-improvement plans, conversions, deployment, and operations.

**Student Housing**
-------------------

* Student housing owners, operators, developers, and management companies, including organizations such as American Campus Communities, Greystar, The Preiss Company, Scion Group, and comparable companies.
* University housing departments and campus technology stakeholders that act as direct clients, operating stakeholders, or standards authorities.
* Public-private partnership organizations involved in developing and operating student housing.
* Construction, integration, access-control, and connectivity stakeholders supporting new development, renovations, high-density student communities, and annual turnover cycles.

**Venues**
----------

* Venue owners such as municipalities, school districts, colleges, private owners and developers, fairgrounds, cultural organizations, and comparable entities.
* Venue operators, promoters, tenant organizations, leagues, and event producers, including organizations such as VenuWorks, OVG360, ASM Global, and comparable companies.
* Architects, general contractors, low-voltage contractors, AV integrators, life-safety specialists, and other design-build participants.
* Organizations responsible for new venue development, renovation, connected venue systems, guest and staff operations, event-day reliability, sponsorship activation, and revenue-generating experiences.

**Property Lifecycle Coverage**
-------------------------------

* Influence technology and managed-service decisions across new development, acquisition and redevelopment, renovation and property-improvement planning, construction, installation, commissioning, property opening, ongoing operations, capital planning, and technology refresh cycles.
* Recognize when decision authority shifts among owners, developers, operators, brands, institutions, contractors, technology stakeholders, and service providers across the lifecycle.

**Market Intelligence & Internal Leadership**
=============================================

* Maintain a current, evidence-based view of priority organizations, decision-makers, market structures, development and renovation pipelines, capital plans, and operating trends in each segment.
* Translate relationships and market knowledge into clear decisions, recommendations, risks, and next actions for Calix leaders.
* Represent Calix at relevant real estate, hospitality, student housing, venue, construction, property-technology, and managed-services forums where target stakeholders participate.
* Coordinate with the broader MSP ecosystem program so property relationships support MSP specialization and Managed Business objectives.
* Create partner dashboards, portfolio views, opportunity assessments, and executive updates that support disciplined relationship management.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Real Estate, Hospitality Management, Urban Development, Marketing, Technology, Telecommunications, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in strategic partnerships, business development, ecosystem development, property partnerships, hospitality partnerships, venue partnerships, or a closely related function.
* Deep expertise and active relationships within at least one of the following ecosystems: Multifamily / MDU, Hospitality, Student Housing, or Venues; demonstrated familiarity with at least one additional segment is strongly preferred.
* An established network of executive, operating, development, technology, procurement, construction, and deployment relationships at relevant organizations serving one or more target segments.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and prioritize high-impact organizations rather than applying a broad, undifferentiated relationship-management approach.
* Proven success establishing strategic relationships, market-development initiatives, advisory programs, go-to-market collaborations, or ecosystem programs involving owners, developers, operators, management companies, builders, integrators, or adjacent organizations.
* Strong understanding of how ownership structures, property or venue operations, capital plans, development and renovation cycles, procurement practices, and technology standards influence buying decisions.
* Experience connecting end-market relationships to MSPs, managed network providers, systems integrators, VARs, or other indirect service-delivery partners.
* Experience working directly with Product Management or Product Group teams to shape requirements, validate solutions, or inform segment strategy.
* Experience collaborating with Marketing on vertical strategy, positioning, campaigns, events, executive engagement, or partner activation.
* Strong executive communication, relationship management, negotiation, judgment, and cross-functional influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Direct relationships with major developers, owners, operators, management companies, hotel brands, REITs, university housing organizations, venue operators, construction companies, architects, contractors, or integrators relevant to the four target segments.
* Expertise spanning more than one target segment, with the ability to recognize common buying patterns and segment-specific differences.
* Experience with managed Wi-Fi, broadband, networking, smart-building technology, PropTech, guest technology, campus technology, connected venues, or managed-services business models.
* Experience supporting solution validation, pilot programs, reference designs, strategic alliances, or market advisory initiatives.
* Credibility and active participation in relevant property, hospitality, student housing, venue, construction, technology, or managed-services communities and conferences.
* MBA or related advanced degree.

This role on BMO’s Corporate Real Estate (CRE) team is responsible for the oversight and delivery of BMO’s office and critical environments projects globally. The role includes the leadership of BMO’s internal team of professionals who oversee delivery through BMO’s third-party service providers and ensures a globally consistent and integrated approach.

  

The position is a key point of integration within the CRE team and with the bank’s other internal support functions who help deliver real estate projects including technology, procurement, security, finance and risk. It also serves as a liaison with BMO’s internal lines of business during project execution to ensure project objectives are achieved.

The ideal candidate is an experienced real estate leader with proven delivery capabilities, excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment on complex mission-critical initiatives.

  

**Key Accountabilities for Office and Critical Environments Projects**

**Team Development**

* Leads, manages and develops BMO’s internal team responsible for the oversight of all office and critical environments (CE) projects globally.
* Provide direction, coaching, prioritization and performance oversight to the BMO project team.
* Establishes consistent delivery standards, practices and performance expectations, and drives continuous improvement.
Fosters a culture aligned to BMO’s purpose, values and strategy, promotes inclusion, establishes clear expectations and holds the team accountable for results.  

  

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Acts as relationship lead and trusted advisor to BMO leadership, project sponsors and stakeholders, aligning business objectives, priorities and measures of success with portfolio strategy and delivery.
* Ensures cross-functional alignment across the various CRE teams to ensure that responsibilities, handoffs & accountabilities are clear throughout the real estate life-cycle from strategy through to operations.
* Ensures active engagement with all operations teams and leadership through planning, commissioning, and the transition to operations.
* Leads alignment and builds relationships with CRE’s enterprise support partners, including Technology, Security, Procurement, Finance and Risk.
Leads the resolution of issues, removes roadblocks and escalates material risks, unresolved commitments and decisions.  

  

**Delivery Accountability, Oversight & Strategy**

* Accountable for the delivery of all BMO’s portfolio of office and CE projects including determining the appropriate levels of internal oversight, integration, reporting and governance.
* Oversight of all priorities, sequencing, resources and interdependencies to enable consistent and effective delivery of projects, which also includes any office and CE programs.
* Monitors project performance and provides executive reporting on progress, financial performance, risks, issues, decisions and required actions.
* Drives timely stakeholder requirements, resources, commitments, decisions and approvals required to meet project delivery objectives.
* Provides project sponsors and BMO leadership with strategic advice on business cases, priorities, key decisions, risks, trade-offs, and realization of expected business benefits.
* Accountable for capital stewardship, including project budgeting, forecasting, change control, contingency management and adherence to BMO capital governance and approval requirements.
Provides change leadership, ensuring stakeholder readiness, communications and change management activities to support achievement of expected business benefits.  

  

**Supplier Oversight & Third-Party Risk Management**

* Manages and builds strong partnerships with third-party service delivery partners and provides strategic direction and oversight of their performance.
* Accountability for delivery, service quality and defined outcomes including key delivery metrics including scope, schedule and budget targets.
* Ensures delivery by third parties is consistent with contractual agreements (MSAs) and aligned with BMO requirements, enterprise standards and approved objectives
Advises on the performance and selection of all project service delivery partners, including participating in BMO Procurement’s evaluation and selection process  

  

**Governance, Risk and Compliance Management**

* Ensures compliance within BMO’s governance, risk & regulatory requirements including enterprise project and program management requirements.
* Proactively identifies interdependencies, risks and stakeholder impacts and ensures appropriate mitigation and resolution strategies are established
* Leads and represents projects and programs in governance forums, ensuring decisions, actions, accountabilities and escalations are followed through to completion.
Establishes and maintains appropriate controls related to projects and acts as liaison with internal audit and risk groups where appropriate.  

  

**Qualifications**

* 9+ years of relevant experience and/or certification in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing senior program and project management professionals responsible for complex, interdependent initiatives.
* Extensive experience leading large Corporate Real Estate office projects and programs involving business groups, enterprise functions and third-party service delivery partners.
* Experience leading mission critical engineering projects and programs.
* Experience leading projects across multiple geographies and working effectively with regional stakeholders is an asset.
* Strong knowledge of project and program management methodologies, governance, financial management and risk management.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) designation from the Project Management Institute (PMI) is an asset.
* Strong executive presence, with the ability to translate complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and required actions.
* Expert stakeholder management skills.
* Expert influence and negotiation skills.
* Expert verbal and written communication skills.
* Expert analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Strong collaboration and cross-functional leadership skills.
Ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities and challenging stakeholder environments effectively.  

  

**BMO Risk Accountability**

* Takes measured risks while protecting the Bank by applying BMO’s Risk Management Framework in the execution of the role, in line with BMO’s Risk Culture and approved Risk Appetite.
* Makes sound, risk-informed decisions that align with business strategy, protect assets and adhere to applicable policies, standards, procedures, laws and regulations.

Title: Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Manager
Description:
**Location:** Canada or United States (Remote / Hybrid; East Coast preferred, Greater Toronto Area a plus)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent

**About Adonis Partners**

At Adonis Partners, we exist to help our clients become more profitable — and their people more capable. We show up to do the real work, shoulder-to-shoulder with our clients, committed to creating lasting, measurable impact.

We are a fast-growing business excellence consultancy of 60 professionals across North America, serving over 30 clients annually.

We combine data-driven insights, deep industry experience, and lived leadership to cut through complexity and deliver results. Our team is built on a foundation of openness, humility, and relentless value creation. That’s how we’ve earned trust — and why clients call us back.

We partner most often with companies in:

* Food & Beverage Manufacturing
* Healthcare and Life Sciences
* Packaging
* Transportation, Logistics, and Supply Chain

Our clients are typically upper mid-market ($200M to $2B in revenue), including PE-backed companies undergoing operational transformation. Engagements range from 3–12 months, often involving immersive, on-site collaboration.

**Our Values (How We Work)**

* Genuine, Transparent & Fair – We tell the truth, even when it’s hard.
* Relentless in Creating Value – We own the outcome, no matter the obstacles.
* Always Getting Better – We seek feedback and grow through experience.
* Move Fast – We take action with urgency and accountability.
* Go the Extra Mile – We roll up our sleeves and do what it takes.

We live a service philosophy based on vulnerability, humility, and radical honesty. It’s not always comfortable, but it builds the kind of trust that lasts.

**Position Summary**

As the Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Specialist, you will own and deliver full-cycle recruitment for Adonis Partners across Canada and the United States. You will work closely with company leadership and practice leaders to understand current and upcoming client engagement needs, translate those needs into clear talent profiles, and identify high-calibre consultants and professionals who can deliver measurable results for our clients.

This role requires more than general recruiting experience. You will develop targeted talent pipelines across consulting, supply chain, procurement, operational excellence, Lean Six Sigma, and business transformation. You will recruit for both permanent and project-based needs, build relationships with experienced independent consultants, and help ensure Adonis Partners can respond quickly to client requirements while maintaining a high standard of candidate experience.

**Key Responsibilities Recruitment Strategy & Workforce Planning**

* Partner with leadership and practice leads to understand business priorities, client demand, upcoming projects, and resource requirements.
* Clarify role requirements, including technical capabilities, industry experience, consulting experience, seniority, location, availability, travel expectations, and engagement duration.
* Develop practical sourcing and recruitment plans for permanent hires, contract professionals, and project-based consulting resources.
* Prioritize recruitment activities based on client timelines, business needs, and the availability of qualified talent.
* Provide market feedback on talent availability, candidate expectations, compensation ranges, and recruitment challenges across Canada and the United States.

**Consulting & Industry-Specific Talent Sourcing**

Identify and attract professionals across Adonis Partners’ core service areas, including:

* **Supply Chain & Procurement:** Supply Chain Transformation Consultants, Procurement Consultants, Strategic Sourcing Specialists, Category Management Professionals, S&OP and Planning Specialists, Inventory Optimization Experts, Logistics and Distribution Professionals, and Supplier Performance Specialists.
* **Operational & Business Excellence**: Lean Six Sigma practitioners (Green Belt, Black Belt, and Master Black Belt), Operational Excellence Consultants, Business Excellence Consultants, Continuous Improvement Leaders, Process Improvement Specialists, and Change Management Professionals.
* **Business & Transformation**: Management Consultants, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Program Managers, Business Systems Analysts, Data Analysts, and Business Intelligence Professionals.
* Assess candidates for the combination of functional expertise, industry knowledge, problem-solving ability, communication, facilitation, and client-facing skills required in consulting environments.
* Recognize the difference between candidates with operational experience and practitioners who have successfully led or delivered transformation and improvement initiatives.

**Full-Cycle Recruitment & Candidate Assessment**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, sourcing, resume screening, introductory calls, structured interviews, candidate shortlisting, interview coordination, reference checks, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff.
* Conduct initial candidate interviews to assess experience, consulting capabilities, project examples, communication skills, motivation, compensation expectations, location, and availability.
* Evaluate candidates against role-specific criteria and provide clear, evidence-based recommendations to hiring stakeholders.
* Coordinate technical, functional, and leadership interviews with practice leaders and other interviewers.
* Maintain timely and professional communication with candidates throughout the process, including feedback and status updates.
* Support offer discussions and closing activities while ensuring candidate expectations are aligned with the role and engagement requirements.

**Canada & United States Talent Acquisition**

* Build and maintain active talent pipelines across Canadian and US markets for current and anticipated hiring needs.
* Use LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, referrals, job boards, industry groups, and other sourcing channels to identify qualified candidates.
* Develop an understanding of regional talent markets, role availability, compensation expectations, and relevant employment practices.
* Confirm candidate location, work authorization status, willingness to travel, and availability for the relevant role or client assignment.
* Coordinate with leadership and appropriate internal or external resources when cross-border work authorization or employment considerations require review; do not provide legal or immigration advice.
* Adapt sourcing strategies to support remote, hybrid, and client-site assignments across North America.

**Talent Pipeline & Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain a searchable network of qualified consultants and professionals, including independent consultants and contract talent.
* Maintain accurate candidate profiles covering skills, industry experience, project history, certifications, location, availability, compensation expectations, and engagement preferences.
* Build long-term relationships with high-potential candidates, including individuals who may not be suitable for an immediate opening but could fit future engagements.
* Create talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill capabilities, particularly in procurement, supply chain, operational excellence, and Lean Six Sigma.
* Re-engage previously screened or placed candidates as new client requirements arise.

**Recruitment Operations, Systems & Reporting**

* Maintain complete and accurate candidate and recruitment records in Salesforce or the company’s designated recruitment tracking system.
* Track each recruitment requirement from intake through placement, including sourcing activity, candidate status, interview feedback, decisions, and outcomes.
* Prepare regular recruitment pipeline updates for leadership, highlighting progress, bottlenecks, risks, and support required.
* Monitor recruitment metrics such as time to shortlist, time to fill, qualified candidates presented, interview conversion, offer acceptance, and successful placements.
* Develop and improve standardized job descriptions, interview guides, candidate scorecards, recruitment workflows, and reporting templates.
* Maintain confidentiality and handle candidate information responsibly and in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

Title: Restaurant Technology Manager
Description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Restaurant Technology Manager – UAE is the single point of accountability for all restaurant technology across the UAE market, reporting directly to the Global Head of Technology Operations. The role leads the delivery, support and continuous improvement of all in-store and guest-facing technology across brands, including POS/MIS, BSP, Digital, ALMP, Kiosk, Digital Menu Boards, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, as well as store networks, Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals. The role also manages the restaurant technology vendor portfolio end to end, including contracts, SLAs, service reviews, billing and invoice validation, and payment tracking with Finance and Procurement. By maximizing restaurant uptime, enabling fast incident resolution and ensuring accurate, cost-effective technology spend, the role protects restaurant sales and guest experience while supporting growth and digital ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Restaurant Technology Ownership:**
  Own the end-to-end management of all restaurant technology components in the UAE – POS / MIS, BSP, Digital ordering, ALMP, Kiosk, DMB, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, store network / Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals – ensuring stable, secure and standardised operation across all brands.
* **Service Operations & Incident Management:**
  Lead the UAE restaurant technology support team; define, implement and continually improve incident, problem, request and change management processes in line with ITIL and ATO standards.
* **Escalation & Major Incident Management:**
  Act as the escalation point for UAE restaurant operations both in and out of hours; lead major incidents, stakeholder communication and root cause analysis (RCA).
* **Vendor Management:**
  Manage all UAE restaurant technology vendors and service providers (POS / hardware, kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, network / telecom, payment, aggregator integration, field service): onboarding, SOWs, SLA governance, monthly service reviews, vendor scorecards, penalties / service credits and renewals, in coordination with Procurement and Legal.
* **Vendor Billing & Invoice Validation:**
  Validate every vendor invoice before approval against contract rates, POs, SOWs, asset / license / site counts, delivered services, GRNs and SLA performance; identify and recover over-billing, duplicate charges and unapplied credits.
* **Vendor Payment Validation & Tracking:**
  Validate and track vendor payments with Finance / Accounts Payable; maintain the vendor payment and accruals tracker, ensure payments are released on time and only for accepted deliverables, and resolve vendor payment disputes.
* **Budget & Cost Management:**
  Prepare and manage the UAE restaurant technology opex and capex budget; track actuals vs budget and forecast; drive cost optimisation across licenses, maintenance contracts, telecom and hardware.
* **New Store Openings, Remodels & Rollouts:**
  Deliver restaurant technology for new store openings, remodels, relocations and closures, and lead UAE rollouts of new technology (kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital) on time, on budget and to standard.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Maintain an accurate register of restaurant hardware, software licenses and spares; plan lifecycle refresh and manage the spares pool.
* **Information Security & Compliance:**
  Ensure restaurant technology complies with Americana IT security policies, PCI-DSS for card payments and UAE regulatory requirements, including patching, endpoint protection and access control.
* **Stakeholder Management & Reporting:**
  Partner with UAE Operations, Brands, Marketing, Digital, Finance and Procurement; provide monthly service, vendor and spend performance reporting to the Global Head of Technology Operations; keep SOPs, KEDB, network diagrams and the vendor contract register up to date.
* **People Leadership:**
  Lead, coach and develop the team; set objectives, run mid-year and annual reviews, build individual development and succession plans, and manage shift and on-call rosters.
* **Other Duties:**
  Undertake other duties as assigned by the Global Head of Technology Operations.

**Qualification: -**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Master’s degree / MBA is preferred.
* ITIL v4 Foundation (or higher) certification required; PMP / PRINCE2 preferred.

**Experience: -**

* 10+ years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in a managerial role in restaurant, QSR, hospitality or retail technology.
* Excellent knowledge of restaurant technology systems and infrastructure – POS (NCR / Oracle an advantage), kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital ordering, loyalty and aggregator integrations.
* Must have delivered and supported solutions for an estate of 150+ stores; UAE / GCC experience strongly preferred.
* Proven vendor management experience, including contract and SLA management, vendor billing / invoice validation and payment reconciliation.
* Experience owning an IT opex / capex budget and reporting actuals vs budget.
* Has been through or led significant change within a restaurant or retail technology environment.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* ITIL service management – incident, problem, change and request management.
* Strong vendor and contract management, negotiation and commercial acumen.
* Invoice, billing and payment validation; financial controls, accruals and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of retail networks, payment security (PCI-DSS) and endpoint management.
* ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and reporting / analytics (Excel, Power BI)
* Project and rollout management for multi-site deployments.

**Major Challenges:**

* 24/7 restaurant operations with late-night and delivery trading; on-call and out-of-hours escalations are part of the role.
* Large multi-brand estate across all Emirates with differing technology stacks, channels (dine-in, drive-thru, kiosk, delivery, aggregators) and brand requirements.
* Managing many vendors with different SLAs, contract and billing models; ensuring every invoice reflects contracted rates and delivered service, and resolving billing and payment disputes without disrupting restaurant service.
* Balancing cost control and budget discipline with restaurant uptime and guest experience; dependencies on third-party platforms (aggregators, payment providers, telecom) outside direct control.
* Fast new-store and rollout pipeline with tight, fixed opening dates.
* Frequent travel to restaurants across the UAE.

**Leadership Traits:**

* Business Succession Planning
* Business Acumen
* Entrepreneurship
* Budgets and Financial Reports
* Crisis Management

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth, improving store profitability, managing inventory, overseeing buying and merchandising activities, developing supplier relationships and ensuring an excellent customer experience across all locations.

* Ensure stores maintain attractive layouts, effective product displays, proper visual merchandising and a positive shopping environment.
* Identify opportunities to improve store productivity, sales conversion and customer experience.

* Oversee stock management across all stores, ensuring optimal inventory levels and product availability.
* Monitor fast-moving, slow-moving and ageing stock and implement appropriate actions to improve stock turnover and sell-through.
* Plan replenishment and stock transfers between stores based on sales trends, inventory levels and customer demand.
* Oversee product buying and ordering activities, ensuring purchasing decisions are aligned with sales forecasts, market demand and business objectives.
* Analyze product and category performance to identify buying opportunities, reduce excess inventory and improve stock investment.
* Identify new products, brands and emerging toy trends to strengthen the company's product range and drive additional sales.

* Improve team capabilities through training in product knowledge, selling techniques, customer service and store operations.
* Ensure clear communication of targets, responsibilities and operational expectations across all stores.
* Address performance gaps and operational challenges in coordination with Human Resources and relevant departments.

**6. Business Development & Reporting**

* Identify and recommend opportunities to improve store performance, expand product categories and enhance the customer experience.
* Oversee store improvement, renovation and development initiatives in coordination with relevant departments.
* Work closely with Finance, Marketing, Procurement, Supply Chain and Human Resources to ensure effective retail operations.
* Prepare regular management reports covering sales, profitability, inventory, buying, supplier performance, store operations and key business opportunities.
* Present business insights and recommendations to senior management to support commercial and operational decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing or a related field.

* ***Experience in managing multiple retail locations, preferably in toys, children's products, specialty retail*** or a similar consumer retail environment.

* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Commercially minded, results-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced retail environment.

### **An overview of this role**

As a People Safety & Resilience Manager at GitLab, you'll help protect team members working from home, in Labs, and in coworking spaces. You'll turn GitLab's safety and resilience strategies into practical programs that work across countries, both day to day and when a crisis disrupts how people work.

### **What you’ll do**

* Run the occupational health and safety management system in line with ISO 45001. Put the global policy into practice through hazard identification, risk and ergonomic assessments, incident reporting and investigation, performance measurement, internal audits, and management reviews.

* Coordinate required consultation with works councils and team members before GitLab makes a decision or contacts affected team members outside the consultation process. Prepare consultation materials, participate in health and safety committees where they exist, and retain the consent, hearing, and anonymized reporting records each jurisdiction requires.
* Run the workplace violence prevention program. Coordinate the threat management team, train managers, and keep case records and legally required local plans up to date.
* Coordinate crisis response and disaster relief. Keep the crisis plan and records current, with a lead and alternate for every role. During on-call shifts, follow escalation procedures and support the crisis team until the response ends. Work with the relief partner to track the Team Member Disaster Relief fund balance and handle communications and reporting.
* Maintain continuity plans for the People Group, assess the impact of disruptions, and prioritize recovery of essential services. Keep records for auditors and insurers, run crisis and continuity exercises, lead required reviews after incidents, and track follow-up actions until they're complete.
* Assess each requirement in ISO 45001, ISO 22361, and ISO 22301. Each week, review the scores produced by AI agents and correct any errors. Set deadlines for improvements and report quarterly on the safety and resilience measures in the People Safety & Security scorecard.
* Lead people safety and crisis response on site at major company events alongside security operations. Confirm emergency procedures and medical arrangements are in place, serve as the crisis team's on-site contact, and lead a review after each event.

* Experience managing programs across teams, including assigning owners and deadlines, tracking regulatory changes, and preparing records for audits.
* Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) agents to draft materials, score assessments, and update records, and checking their results against the standards. Ability to keep that work repeatable by tracking changes to prompts and workflows in GitLab.
* Ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time to support company events, run exercises, and attend health and safety committee meetings in person. These commitments can fall in the evenings or on weekends.
* Availability outside standard working hours as part of a scheduled on-call duty rotation and when the crisis management plan is activated, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
* Experience managing consultations across Germany, the Netherlands, and France is strongly preferred because you'll work under each country's rules. Title: Senior Health and Safety Manager
Description:
At Mace, our purpose is to redefine the boundaries of ambition. We believe in creating places that are responsible, bringing transformative impact to our people, communities, and societies across the globe. To learn more about our purpose, culture, and priorities, visit our strategy site.

Within our consult business we harness our unique combination of leading-edge practical expertise and project delivery consultancy to unlock the potential in every project.

* Provide visible executive leadership for health, safety, and wellbeing across the program and model Mace’s Safety First value.
* Set and maintain program health and safety strategy, policy, standards, governance, delegated authorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Ensure effective control of critical risks including excavation, shafts, temporary works, lifting, work at height, confined spaces, mobile plant, electrical systems, fire, track access, and simultaneous operations.
* Lead health and safety input into design, constructability, logistics, procurement, construction sequencing, energization, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness.
* Chair executive safety governance and critical-risk reviews, ensuring decisions are evidence-based and actions are owned and closed.
* Exercise authority to stop or defer work where risk is unacceptable, controls are ineffective, or legal and project requirements are not met.
* Promote occupational health, mental health, fatigue management, exposure control, ergonomics, inclusion, and workforce wellbeing.
* Act as the client’s principal health and safety adviser and provide clear recommendations to the program executive and governance bodies.
* Develop and govern the program health and safety management system, assurance plan, critical-risk framework, audit regime, and reporting model.
* Ensure constructors, contractors, designers, and suppliers discharge their legal, contractual, and project health and safety obligations.
* Lead risk-based assurance across stations, shafts, underground works, compounds, rail systems, testing and commissioning, and operational interfaces.
* Own executive reporting on leading and lagging indicators, high-potential events, critical controls, occupational health, regulatory matters, and contractor performance.
* Lead strategic engagement with Ontario regulators, emergency services, joint health and safety committees, workforce representatives, and independent assurance providers.
* Provide health and safety leadership through major transitions including mobilization, excavation, structural completion, fit-out, permanent power, dynamic testing, trial operations, and handover.
* Sponsor serious incident investigations and learning reviews, ensuring systemic causes are addressed and improvements are verified across the program.
* Provide independent, evidence-based advice where schedule, cost, production, or stakeholder pressure conflicts with safe delivery.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, hazards, occupational illnesses, and regulatory interactions are reported and governed transparently.
* Maintain auditable records and ensure executive decisions, acceptance of risk, exemptions, and corrective actions are documented appropriately.
* Challenge normalization of deviance, weak supervision, under-reporting, recurring deficiencies, and superficial close-out.
* Escalate significant legal, safety, reputational, or operational risks promptly with clear options and recommendations.
* Protect workers’ rights and confidentiality while meeting legal, contractual, and governance obligations.
* Lead, structure, and develop the program health and safety function, including senior managers, managers, advisers, inspectors, occupational health resources, and specialist support.
* Establish clear functional accountabilities, competency requirements, succession plans, resource forecasts, and performance expectations.
* Coach program executives, project directors, construction leaders, and contractor leadership to integrate risk control into business and delivery decisions.
* Promote worker engagement, learning teams, joint inspections, critical-control verification, and effective joint health and safety committees.

**You’ll Need To Have:**

* Proven Director-level or head-of-function health and safety leadership experience on major subway, metro, railway, underground, or similarly complex infrastructure programs.
* Demonstrated accountability for multiple contractors, projects, stations, or work packages within a major program environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of underground station construction, deep excavations, shafts, temporary works, lifting, confined spaces, utilities, MEP, rail systems, and commissioning interfaces.
* Thorough knowledge of Ontario occupational health and safety requirements, constructor duties, employer responsibilities, worker rights, and joint health and safety committees.
* Experience designing and governing health and safety management systems, critical-risk frameworks, assurance programs, and executive performance reporting.
* Experience leading serious incident investigations and organizational learning across major projects.
* Ability to influence program executives, clients, contractors, designers, regulators, and workforce representatives.
* Strong executive communication, governance, negotiation, decision-making, coaching, and crisis-management capability.
* A record of improving culture, leading indicators, critical-control effectiveness, contractor accountability, and occupational health outcomes.
* A degree or recognized qualification in occupational health and safety, engineering, construction management, or a related discipline.
* A Canadian Registered Safety Professional designation, Canadian Health and Safety Consultant designation, National Construction Safety Officer designation, or equivalent professional credential is preferred.
* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience, including substantial Director-level or head-of-function responsibility on major infrastructure programs.
* Experience with ISO 45001-aligned management systems, risk-based assurance, human factors, organizational learning, and critical-control management.
* Formal training in incident investigation, auditing, emergency management, occupational hygiene, or behavioural and human factors approaches is advantageous.
* Experience in operational rail environments, underground works, brownfield interfaces, or transit commissioning is strongly preferred.
* A visible, credible, authoritative, and solutions-focused executive leadership style with the confidence to challenge decisions at any level.
* Eligibility to work in Canada and willingness to work across project offices, stations, shafts, tunnels, compounds, and operational environments in the Greater Toronto Area.

**Our values**

**Safety first - Going home safe and well:** We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team.

**Client focus - Deliver on our promise:** We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients.

**Integrity - Always do the right thing:** We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.

**Create opportunity - For our people to excel:** We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

**Note:** The estimated salary for this position is 130,000 - 180,000 CAD. Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills and qualifications.

Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organization.

We are also open to discussing part time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable with-in the role.

Description:

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai.
