We are seeking a Compliance Specialist who will provide compliance, privacy, and enterprise risk management (ERM) program support. The Compliance Specialist applies strong investigative and research skills to support Heritage Health’s compliance, privacy, and enterprise risk management (ERM) programs. Working under the direction of the Director of Compliance and Risk, this role manages assigned projects with minimal day-to-day supervision and serves as a resource on regulatory requirements across the organization. Heritage Health is an FQHC that specializes in primary care, pediatrics, behavioral health, and dental services.

**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm, or 7:30am-4:00pm with potential of being hybrid.

Requirements:

* Minimum 2-3 years’ work experience working in healthcare compliance, privacy, or risk.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including active listening.
* Investigative and research skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Ability to travel between Heritage Health clinic locations.
* If a hybrid work environment is considered, a secure workspace is necessary.
* Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) certification preferred.
* FQHC experience preferred.

**Your Essential Duties:**

* Stay current on, and communicate, changes in healthcare compliance regulations.
* Responsible for researching, reviewing, and interpreting federal and state regulations.
* Assist with creating, maintaining, and delivering education content throughout all levels of the organization, including new employee orientation and organization-wide newsletters.
* Coordinate and assist compliance and ERM projects and workgroups.
* Assist in the review, edit, or creation of compliance, privacy, and ERM program policies and procedures.
* Under the direction of the Director of Compliance and Risk, perform assigned incident investigations and compliance projects while keeping management well apprised of results and completion status.
* Act as a technical resource, answer questions, analyze data, and conduct research.
* Support the Compliance and Risk Committee by drafting agendas, taking minutes, tracking action items, and maintaining records of committee activity.
* Support HRSA site visit readiness and related follow-up.
* Provide compliance oversight of the FTCA deeming application process, including verifying that required documentation and timelines are met by the responsible departments.
* Coordinate and conduct clinic compliance rounding focused on HIPAA privacy and HRSA requirements; track findings to resolution.
* Commitment to professional growth and understanding of the changing environment through current events reading, continuing education, self-study, cross-functional training, and work assignment variation.
* Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this position.
* Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
* Clinical quality and patient safety are managed by the Clinical-Quality department. This role coordinates with Clinical-Quality, Facilities, and other departments as needed on matters that carry compliance, privacy, or enterprise risk implications.

**Your Success Factors:**

* Strong communication, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Maintain ethical practices and organizational integrity.
* Ability to research and understand state and federal laws and regulations and distill it down to the key facts.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Exceptional time management, priority setting skills, and ability to multi-task.
* Proven problem-solving skills.
* Service oriented to consistently engage and build relationships at all levels of the organization to promote a culture of safety and compliance.
* Ability to recognize and assess sensitive situations and compliance matters understanding the need to support confidentiality, and work to resolve issues in a timely manner.

**Job Overview:**

Working Conditions: Work is normally performed in a typical interior/office work environment in an office building. Work may be demanding at times.

Physical/Mental Requirements:

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* May lift up to 15 pounds at times.
* Must be able to access and navigate various departments of a given location.
* Must be able to adhere to process protocol.

**Safety:** Heritage Health enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe working environment. Each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements, participating in emergency response tasks as requested, and

serving on safety committees and teams as requested. In addition, employees must accept the responsibility for maintaining the safety of themselves and others by adhering to all written and verbal instructions, promptly reporting and/or correcting all hazards or unsafe conditions and providing feedback to supervisors and management on all safety issues.

Title: Security Analyst
Description:
Apply now

**Date:** Nov 16, 2026

**Location:** Toronto, ON, CA

**Company:** Hydro One Networks Inc

**52289** **-** **Toronto** **-** **Regular****.**

**Hiring Salary Range**: $71,400.00-92,400.00 / year

  

Hydro One is proud to be the largest electricity transmission and distribution provider in Ontario, serving nearly 1.5 million customers. We have a long history in the industry with our roots dating back over 110 years to 1906. Since then, we have worked to grow and evolve to meet the changing needs of our customers and communities across Ontario. Today, we’re focused on providing exceptional customer service and ensuring we are building safe communities where we live, work and play.

It’s an exciting time to join the team at Hydro One!

  

**Job Function:**

Reporting to the Security Training, Awareness & Communications team within Security, this role supports the planning, development, delivery, and continuous improvement of the organization's Security Training, Awareness & Communications Program. The position contributes to a broad range of initiatives that promote a strong security culture and enhance employee understanding of both physical and cyber security responsibilities across the organization.

  

Working closely with stakeholders across Security and the business, the role supports the delivery of security training programs, awareness campaigns, communication initiatives, employee engagement activities, learning technologies, and related programs designed to increase awareness, promote secure behaviours, and reduce organizational risk.

  

Responsibilities may include supporting training development and administration, program coordination, content development, reporting and analytics, stakeholder engagement, event coordination, communications planning, and the implementation and maintenance of tools and platforms that support security education, awareness, training, and engagement initiatives.

  

This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy a combination of communications, employee engagement, project coordination, training, and security awareness activities.

  

**Job Description:**

* Conduct studies and recommend solutions on security systems provided by the Department, such as building security, electronic security monitoring systems, security computer software and hardware, assessment of security products, systems and fire security products, employee security systems, and multi-functional employee ID cards for building and parking access, car rental, and other various Hydro services. Prepare problem analysis, develop and define alternative solutions, including options to make or buy, replace or modify. Analyze and evaluate alternative solutions, estimate costs and formulate prototype solutions where necessary. Identify and estimate costs, quantify benefits and make effective recommendations on security systems and services that meet Federal, Provincial, Municipal legislative requirements, Corporate security policies, and client requirements.
* Provide consultative support, guidance and information to Head Office employees on all security systems and services provided by the Department to ensure a safe and secure workplace environment. Monitor the effectiveness and efficiency of the systems and services, and effect, guide or recommend corrective actions to ensure problems are resolved. Work with Corporate, Divisional or external groups, such as local law enforcement agencies and emergency response groups, to ensure security systems and services meet specific client requirements. Provide assistance to other parts of the organization to meet any special requirements they might have.
* Prepare documentation for retaining consultants, contractors, etc, and co-ordinate project work activities and plans within the Department and with other Divisional and Corporate Departments; assign work to consultants and contractors, and administer and monitor the cost and progress of the project to ensure it remains on schedule and within budget. Inspect the work or installations carried out to ensure work quality meets all specifications and complies with contracts. Conduct post-implementation reviews with clients and ensure their requirements are met. Be familiar with all site electronic devices and their operation and work effectively with other groups to keep these systems operational as intended. Take appropriate action in the event of system, equipment or procedural failures to ensure problems are corrected and systems and equipment are returned to service.
* Initiate inquiries and investigations resulting from complaints or information about theft, fraud, willful damage, vandalism, accidents, fire, etc. Conduct investigations of a serious or sensitive nature. Write and edit detailed security investigation and accident reports.
* Prepare recommendations for senior management approval for disaster recovery and emergency evacuation plans for all Head Office sites Test and monitor their effectiveness to ensure they meet Corporate requirements, and conform to established security standards.
* Provide appropriate training to security and other Department staff, and Head Office employees on security systems and services. Conduct demonstration sessions including identifying the training needs of operating staff. Prepare operating materials as required, conduct classroom sessions and provide individualized instruction where necessary, and act as a resource person for self-instruction.
* Respond to emergency alarm situations by directing and co ordinating security staff, Ontario Hydro staff and members of the public to ensure their personal safety. Make changes to procedures during emergency situations as necessary.
* Be responsible for the work of assigned staff, by planning, organizing, assigning and checking their work, and giving advice, guidance and direction as necessary, in a working environment which is consistent with the philosophy and goals of continuous quality improvement. Refer all personnel issues to Supervisor for resolution.
* Participate in the development and maintenance of Departmental planning, work organization, scheduling processes, site security procedures, policies and programs.
* Act as a Special Constable and Peace Officer as required.
* Within the general context of the job responsibilities, make suggestions to Supervisor on how to improve the effectiveness of the unit and the services it provides.
* Perform other duties as required.
  

**Selection Criteria**

* Experience supporting employee communications, awareness, engagement, training, change management, or program delivery initiatives.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation development skills, with experience creating communication materials, presentations, training content, or employee resources.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Experience collaborating with stakeholders across multiple business functions and levels of an organization.
* Strong analytical skills with experience collecting, analyzing, and reporting on program metrics and performance indicators.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint, and Forms.
* Knowledge of physical security, cybersecurity, or risk management would be considered an asset.
* Experience supporting awareness campaigns, employee engagement programs, communications initiatives, learning programs, or champion/ambassador networks would be considered an asset.
* Demonstrated initiative, creativity, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  

**Education:**

* University degree or college diploma in Communications, Business Administration, Marketing, Cyber Security, Education, or a related discipline.

KEO Group is seeking a talented and detail-oriented **Document Controller** to join our **Design team in Saudi Arabia**.

* Managing and maintaining project documentation in accordance with established document control procedures and project requirements.

* Ensuring superseded documentation is clearly identified and appropriately archived to prevent unintended use.
* Supporting internal reviews and audits by ensuring document-control records are complete, accurate and readily available.
* Liaising with internal teams and external stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and document-control issues.
* Maintaining confidentiality and appropriate access controls for sensitive project information.
* Supporting continuous improvement of document-control processes and workflows.

* Experience with ETL processes, data mapping, transformation and data validation.

* Experience with BI and data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or equivalent.

Title: Physiotherapist
Description:
Physiotherapists treat patients with physical difficulties resulting from illness, injury, disability or ageing. They treat people of all ages including children, the elderly, stroke patients and people with sports injuries . They work with patients to identify and improve their movement and function. They help promote their patients' health and wellbeing and assist the rehabilitation process by developing and restoring body systems, in particular the neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and respiratory systems. They devise and review treatment programs, comprising manual therapy, movement, therapeutically exercise and the application of technological equipment, e.g. IDD therapy. Physiotherapists also provide advice on how to prevent injury.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corresponding Key Activities performed by the role**

  

**Managerial**

* Maintaining sufficient inventory of material supplies and equipment for performance of duties

  + Reporting shortage of materials to supervisor at earliest convenience, maintaining records for ordering and replenishments

  

**Technical**

* Undertake duties in accordance with the philosophy, business practices and policies of NMCRH-DIP, and practicing within the standards and ethics of the Physiotherapy profession typical work activities include :

  + Working with patients to identify physical problems.

    - Developing and reviewing treatment programs.
    - Assisting patients with joint and spinal problems, especially following surgery.
    - Helping patients' rehabilitation following accidents, injury and stroke.
    - Writing patient case notes and reports.
    - Collecting patient statistics.
    - Educating and advising patients and their cares about how to prevent and/or improve conditions.
  + Working as a professional member of a multi-disciplinary rehabilitation team and actively participating in team meetings.

  + Effectively communicating with staff members, health professionals, clients and family with regards to provision of physiotherapy services.
  + Contributing to, and participating in, education programs for residents, relatives and staff.
  + Participating in continuing education and courses updating Physiotherapy techniques and information.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy equipment is adequately maintained and liaising with the head of department for the ordering of supplies and equipment.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy treatments are based on sound evidence of benefit.
  + Ensuring all adverse clinical events are recorded and reported.
  + Maintaining a safe work environment.
  + Assisting in the on-going maintenance of a safe work place through involvement in the implementation of safe systems of work.
  + Identifying and reporting hazards in the workplace.
  + Participating in Quality Management System and commitment to processes of continuous improvement activities, including auditing, surveys and needs analysis.
  + Other duties as directed by the Head of Department.

  

**Quality and Safety**

* Promoting and maintaining quality in all services and ensure continuous quality improvement measures are in place. Conduct method evaluation/ development as per standard policies and procedures

  + Complying with all safety and quality control programs and procedures as applicable
  + Complying with applicable precautions for environmental safety, infection control, using a series of interventions that minimize or prevent cross infections
  + Ensuring that safety procedures and quality assurance tests are maintained within all sections
  + Comply and support clinical audit processes within the service and report on these as agreed
  + Communicating in a professional and courteous manner with patients, family and other medical personnel as necessary to obtain information for laboratory records, explain procedures, clarify orders and communicate status.

  

**Continuous Education**

* Participating in education sessions for department staff, doctors and nurses on the safe and secure handling of equipment, i.e teaching, induction, peer review, case studies, and clinical presentations

  + Participating in department programs/ committees, various hospital committees, and staff meeting (when requested)
  + Participating in the orientation and training of new employees
  + Maintaining professional knowledge by attending lectures, seminars or on-line education sessions
  + Completing and maintaining all regulatory requirements including licensure and certification and other mandatory training within established time frames.
  + The ability to apply technical skills, together with a demonstrable knowledge of and interest in sciences, such as anatomy, physiology and physics;

  

**Occupational Safety and Health Management Systems**

* Comply with all OSH and infection control policies, standards and procedures and cooperate with hospital management to comply those requirements

  + Notifying OSH Hazards, incidents, Near misses and issues and assistance with the preparation of risk assessments, incident reports
  + Attend applicable OSH/Infection control training programs, mock drills and awareness programs
  + Comply with reasonable OSH instructions, policies and safe working procedures
  + Use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems.
  + Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedures
  + Not wilfully or recklessly endanger anyone’s health and safety
  + Comply with Waste management procedures and policies. Reduce, Reuse, Recycling of waste as much as possible
  + Attend all OSH Trainings, awareness programs and mock drills.
  + Participates in the OSHMS audits, inspections, ensuring standards are maintained

  + The strictest hand hygiene, 5 moments of hand hygiene, bare below the elbows and environmental care, will be expected of all staff, including the post holder, at all times

  

**Qualification, Licensure, Experience and Special Skills:**

  

**Qualifications & licensure**

**Required:**

* Graduate from an approved College or University in Physiotherapy.
* Current license in country of origin with DHA license to practice in Dubai,U.A.E.

Title: Claims Officer
Description:
**\*\*\*PREFERENCE WILL BE GIVEN TO QATARI CANDIDATES\*\*\***
-------------------------------------------------------------

**Reporting structure**
-----------------------

**Reports to:** Head of Chartering

**Direct Reportees:** None

**Location:** Doha

**Job Summary and Purpose**
---------------------------

Monitor and timely process claims related to Nakilat’s commercially managed fleet, collaborate and align with all related stakeholders internally to get the best possible outcomes via the charterparty terms and/or support in negotiations with the relevant counterparties.

**Key Accountabilities 1**
--------------------------

* Build a well-established knowledge of charter parties and their commercial implications in any regard that may result in exposure to claims.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels against the charter parties and highlight any areas that may result in any demurrage, performance warranty and off-hire claims, as necessary.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels in line with charter party warranties and generate a monthly summary report highlighting any areas of over/underperformance (actual and potential). Further, follow up immediately with the vessels’ technical manager to address any underperformance observations or concerns.
* Recommend actions to resolve performance issues and continuously work towards the performance and efficiency of the fleet of ships.
* Monitor, track, and execute relevant cost reimbursement claims to charterers while liaising with the relevant internal stakeholders, i.e. Insurance, Finance, Fleet, etc.
* Provide relevant documents and information to successfully address any audit (internal and/or external) requirements.
* Support chartering & post fixture activities by ensuring compliance with charter party terms.
* Ensure compliance with proper procedures regarding management and approval of claims with reference to the respective and relevant internal lines of approval.
* Monitor and track the Charterers’ accounts, in collaboration with Finance, from a financial perspective to highlight any areas of concern where transactions would need attention. i.e. Hire, claims, cost reimbursement, etc.
* Facilitate regular meetings with Charterers for business discussions on the topic of claims, as required.

**Key Accountabilities 2**
--------------------------

**Legal and Insurance:**

* Review terms of Charter Party with Legal and Insurance functions and ensure that company’s interests are protected by ensuring necessary insurance coverage is in place, proper defense is arranged through vessels’ P&I Club and finally seek reimbursement of relevant expenses from charterers as per charter party clauses.
* Negotiate TCP claims, seek legal advice and provide recommendations to Head of Chartering.

**Planning:**

* Use all possible means for voyage planning including the use of software tools to monitor and coordinate all activities related to voyage. Also, analyze variance between the voyage plans versus the actual plan, while generating report for the Head of Chartering.
* Support the team in coordinating the periodical meetings with vessels’ technical manager to address any technical/operational issues which could have a commercial impact as well as address any customers’ concerns.
* Support the team in coordinating timely between Charterers and vessels’ technical manager to conduct any Owners’ related matters (e.g., SIRE, Crew change, spares delivery, lube oil supply) with minimum deviation and minimum (target zero) off hire & claim avoidance.

**Generic Accountabilities**
----------------------------

**Quality, Health, Safety, & Environment (QHSE):**

* Adhere to all relevant SHEQ policies, procedures, instructions, and controls so that NAKILAT provides a safe, world class, secure and environmentally responsible service to customers, the public and its own people.
* Track EUETS reports, procure EUAs and seek re-imbursement from charterers.
* Track Fuel EU compliance balance and other environmental regulations related to commercial settlement with charterers.

**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures:**

* Implement approved policies, processes, and procedures, and provide instructions to subordinates to ensure their proper implementation.
* Recommend updates for the division’s relevant P&Ps for claims, as deemed appropriate to cope with evolving business needs.

**Qualifications, Experience and Job Skills**
---------------------------------------------

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Business/Economics/Technical of Marine Engineering or any other relevant field.
* Diploma in ship management and operations (ICS preferred).
* Diploma in ship chartering (ICS preferred).

**Experience:**

* A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience as a charterer, shipping and commercial operator in a ship-owning company, chartering desk, trading desk, International Oil & Gas Company, or brokerage house.
* Ideally most recent position should involve commercial and post-fixture operations of vessels preferably LNGCs, VLGCs or tankers.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* Experience in contracts and claims negotiation will be an added advantage.
* Good knowledge of Shipping Commercial management – Chartering and Post-fixture Operations.
* Good record of leading and managing claims negotiations and minimizing commercial exposure.

Title: Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting
Description:
### **Welcome to PxGeo**

PxGeo is an international offshore geophysical services company providing seismic data acquisition and related services to the energy industry. The Group operates across multiple jurisdictions with a head office in Dubai and manages projects in a complex and highly regulated environment.

PxGeo’s operations involve an extensive international supply chain, including vessel chartering, specialist equipment and technology, offshore services, logistics, and a broad range of suppliers and contractors. The Legal function supports commercial arrangements across multiple countries and legal frameworks, with a significant proportion of the Group’s contracts governed by English law.

### **What's the role?**

Official job title is Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting and will be based in Dubai, UAE.

This position provides senior-level legal support to PxGeo’s commercial, operational and Supply Chain activities.

The role will take ownership of complex and strategically important commercial agreements, provide practical and commercially focused legal advice throughout the contracting lifecycle, and support the development of consistent contracting standards across the Group.

The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Technical Solutions, Finance, Supply Chain, Sales and other business functions. The role requires the ability to lead contractual negotiations independently, identify and communicate material legal and commercial risks, and develop workable solutions that support PxGeo’s operational objectives while appropriately protecting the Group’s interests. Key responsibilities include:  
  
**Commercial Contracting**

* Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value and strategically significant commercial agreements.
* Provide legal support in connection with contracts relating to:
* + offshore and seismic services; vessel chartering and marine services;
  + specialist equipment and technology; equipment supply, rental, hire and leasing;
  + agency, logistics, freight and transportation; consultancy and contractor services;
  + software, technology and licensing; framework and master services agreements;
  + purchase orders and associated contractual documentation; and
  + other operational and project-related arrangements.
* Lead negotiations with customers, suppliers, contractors and other commercial counterparties.
* Review and negotiate amendments to PxGeo’s Terms & Conditions.
* Review and negotiate counterparties’ standard terms where PxGeo’s contractual documentation cannot be used.
* Advise on contractual structures and appropriate risk allocation, including:
* + liability and indemnities; consequential and indirect loss;
  + warranties and performance obligations; insurance requirements;
  + intellectual property and data rights; payment and security arrangements;
  + delivery, acceptance and delay; liquidated damages;
  + suspension and termination; force majeure;
  + regulatory compliance; governing law and dispute resolution.
* Provide practical advice on contractual interpretation, contract performance and operational issues arising during project delivery.
* Support the management and resolution of commercial claims and disputes before escalation to formal proceedings.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel where specialist or jurisdiction-specific advice is required.

**Business and Project Support**

* Act as a senior Legal point of contact for commercial and operational matters.
* Work closely with business teams to understand the technical, operational and commercial context of proposed arrangements.
* Participate in project, tender and negotiation meetings where legal input is required.
* Support the identification and management of contractual risks during the tendering, negotiation, mobilisation and performance stages.
* Advise management on material contractual exposures and available mitigation measures.
* Support the development of negotiation strategies for complex or sensitive matters.
* Promote early engagement with Legal so that material risks are identified before commercial positions are agreed.

**Contracting Standards and Legal Processes**

* Support the development, maintenance and implementation of PxGeo’s standard contracts, templates, contractual guidance and fallback positions.
* Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of commercial contracting processes.
* Support efficient workflows and escalation routes between Legal and other functions.
* Provide guidance and support to Legal Counsel/Paralegal and other members of the Legal team on commercial contracting matters.
* Deliver practical training to relevant business functions on contractual risk and contracting procedures.
* Support with other commercial, corporate or strategic matters as required.

### **Who are we looking for?**

* Qualified lawyer with substantial 9+ post-qualification experience, although the quality and relevance of experience will be more important than the precise number of years.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LLB) or Master’s Degree in Law (LLM). English law qualification is desirable but not essential, provided the candidate has strong practical experience with common law commercial contracts.
* Strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements governed by English law or based on English common law principles.
* Demonstrated ability to lead contractual negotiations independently and engage effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external counterparties.
* Detailed understanding of commercial risk allocation.
* Ability to understand technical and operational requirements and translate them into workable contractual arrangements.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material legal risks from matters that can be managed operationally.
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex and time-sensitive matters with limited supervision.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:
* + energy or oil and gas; offshore services; seismic or geophysical services; marine or shipping; vessel chartering; procurement and Supply Chain contracting; or international project-based operations.
* Previous in-house experience within an international, operational or project-based organisation would be a strong advantage.

Title: Safety Engineer
Description:
Core Role and Responsibilities:

* Execute the Project HSE Plan, method statements, risk assessments (JSA/HAZID), and

COSHH controls; maintain evidence of competence and ensure resources for HSE are

adequate and sustained throughout the works

* Maintain all HSE documentation, including audit and inspection reports, and ensure

compliance with all KAHRAMAA and national HSE requirements.

* Participate in toolbox talks, safety briefings ,attend meetings, training sessions, and

workshops as required by KAHRAMAA.

* Enforce KAHRAMAA HSE rules at sites; support the HSE Manager/Coordinator in

developing the training matrix, audit/inspection plans, and coordination with KAHRAMAA on

HSE matters.

* Conduct site HSE inductions; lead toolbox talks; deliver/arrange topic-specific training

(Emergency Response & Preparedness, HAZMAT, Confined Space, Working at Height,

Lockout/Tagout, Electrical Safety, Lifting & Rigging, Power Tool Safety, Excavation Safety,

PPE, Waste Management, Incident Reporting & Investigation, Root Cause Analysis)

* Ensure appropriate PPE is issued, conforms to KAHRAMAA requirements, and is

inspected/maintained regularly (helmets, shoes, goggles/face shields, dust goggles, gloves,

harnesses/lifelines.)

* Maintain site housekeeping and safe storage/handling of materials, including

flammable/hazardous substances; implement controls for hot-work and welding areas with

suitable firefighting equipment.

* Keep portable firefighting equipment available on site from commencement to takeover;

ensure maintenance and mandatory weekly checks; recharge after use and manage stocks

of fresh charges; control open flames and flammable materials per KAHRAMAA instructions.

* Immediately notify KAHRAMAA of accidents/near misses; secure the site/witnesses; submit

Initial Incident Report and final investigation report as per KAHRAMAA guidelines.

Keep accident logs, patient/illness records, and periodic medical exam reporting as required

by national regulations referenced by KAHRAMAA.

* Execute planned audits/inspections; issue NCRs; drive corrective/preventive actions;

escalate unresolved hazards; exercise stop-work authority where necessary; track closure

and communicate changes to personnel

* Oversee electrical safety controls during installation, replacement, testing, commissioning,

and maintenance of LV and HV electricity meters and communication modules, including

working-at-height, energized work controls, lockout/tagout, and safe cabling/antenna

installation in poor-signal areas (subject to KAHRAMAA approval)

* Ensure use of dedicated communication signal strength analyzers (no mobile apps

permitted) when validating AMI communications; coordinate safe handling/transport/storage

of assets with KAHRAMAA access for inspection.

* Maintain daily/weekly/monthly safety reports, inspection logs, incident registers, training

records, and PPE registers; support project progress reporting cadence and WBS execution

phases (Engineering/Procurement/Execution/Close-out) with HSE inputs.

* Provide hard/soft copies of HSE documentation for audits and at KAHRAMAA’s request.

* Coordinate with KAHRAMAA HSE Department, line departments, customers, contractors,

and telecom providers for shutdowns, emergency works, and multi-site mobilization;

participate in emergency drills and ensure readiness of response teams.

* Maintain availability across three shifts in a 24×7 environment; travel between venues/depots

during and outside office hours for inspections, incident response, and verification of

corrective actions (as operationally required).

***Qualification & experience***

* Bachelor’s degree in Fire & Safety, Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering (or

related discipline);

* KAHRAMAA-approved First Aid and Basic Fire Fighting certificates required; ISO

45001/14001 Lead Auditor, Risk Management (QRA/JSA/HAZID) training preferred.

* Demonstrated experience in Construction/Industrial Safety within utility/infrastructure

projects; ability to coordinate and manage HSE issues, conduct audits/incident

investigations, and apply applicable national/international HSE laws.

* Hands-on experience supporting metering roll-outs (including LV/HV Electricity meters) and

AMI field operations with safe methods of work and compliance to KAHRAMAA procedure.

Title: AI Enablement Engineer
Description:
Requisition ID: 278493
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Scotiabank continues to be an industry leader for Payment’s technology and innovation. We have a history of safely leveraging new tools to enable new experiences for our customers, focusing on ensuring we protect their interests and goals. The result of this leads to modernization programs which aim to offer enriched information and transparencies to support the rapidly evolving payments community.

  

**The Role**

As an AI Enablement Engineer, you will serve as the crucial bridge between our enterprise Artificial Intelligence platforms and our workforce. You will drive the adoption, effective utilization, and value realization of generative AI and intelligent productivity tools across the organization.

This is a highly strategic and user-centric role. You will not be responsible for coding, model training, or backend engineering. Instead, your focus will be on human-centric AI adoption: ensuring our teams know how to use these technologies, understand their evolving capabilities, and integrate them seamlessly into their daily workflows to maximize business value.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

  

User Onboarding & Adoption

* Design and execute comprehensive onboarding programs to introduce employees to enterprise AI tools.
* Develop user guides, technical manuals, and structured documentation to support system usage and knowledge transfer.
* Develop role-specific use cases and quick-start guides to help new users overcome initial learning curves.
* Partner with department heads to identify specific workflows that can benefit from AI integration.
* Analyze and create business workflows to improve efficiency and align them with new technology adoption initiatives.
* Lead structured information gathering sessions with stakeholders to identify business needs and opportunities for AI-driven workflow improvements.

  

Capabilities Roadmap & Strategy

* Monitor the evolving landscape of enterprise AI platforms and stay informed on upcoming feature releases.
* Translate vendor roadmaps into internal, business-focused capability roadmaps.
* Assess how new features align with business objectives and communicate these updates to the wider organization.

  

User Training & Education

* Create and deliver engaging training sessions, workshops, and webinars tailored to various technical proficiency levels.
* Develop best-practice resources, such as advanced prompt engineering libraries and functional workflow templates.
* Establish and manage a community of "AI Champions" across different departments to foster peer-to-peer learning.
* Support end-to-end platform delivery by ensuring users are equipped to adopt new tools through structured enablement and guided usage practices.
* Support the delivery and rollout of new platforms, ensuring smooth transition from implementation to user adoption.

  

User Support & Feedback Loop

* Serve as the primary functional point of contact for user questions, best-practice inquiries, and workflow troubleshooting.
* Triage technical bugs or system outages to the core technical engineering/IT teams.
* Gather, synthesize, and advocate for user feedback to shape future AI rollouts and training initiatives.
* Continuously improve workflows and user experience based on feedback gathered during post-implementation support.
* Perform functional validation and testing to ensure solutions align with business requirements and deliver expected user outcomes.

  

Value Realization & Metrics

* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to AI adoption, active usage, and user sentiment.
* Conduct surveys and interviews to measure time saved, productivity gains, and overall ROI of AI initiatives.
* Identify, document, and share internal success stories to drive continued engagement and demonstrate tangible business value.

  

**What You'll Bring:**

* 7+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, technology delivery, architecture, digital transformation, AI enablement or a related technology discipline.
* Experience leading complex technology initiatives across cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery and modern engineering practices.
* Practical experience applying Generative AI or AI-assisted technologies to software engineering, testing, automation or technology operations.
* Understanding of LLMs, Generative AI and emerging AI capabilities, with the ability to translate them into practical technology solutions.
* Experience moving technology initiatives from discovery or proof of concept into implementation and adoption.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work across Engineering, Architecture, Business, Risk and other groups.
* Strong continuous-improvement mindset with demonstrated ability to coach teams and drive adoption of new technology.
* Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems or a related discipline.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Proven experience in technology enablement, change management, customer success, or digital transformation roles.
* **Tech Fluency:** Strong conceptual understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and enterprise productivity suites. No coding or backend development experience is required.
* **Adaptability:** Highly agile and capable of quickly learning new software platforms as our AI toolset evolves.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technological concepts into simple, business-friendly language.
* **Empathy:** A user-first mindset with a strong ability to understand and address the frustrations, fears, or hurdles employees face when adopting disruptive technologies.
* **Analytical:** Ability to track metrics, interpret data adoption, and build reports demonstrating business impact.
* 5-7 years of experience working in a similar capacity as a BA/BSA

* Fluency in Spanish (Nice to Have).

**What's in it for you?**

This role offers exposure to a wide range of technologies, problem domains, and stakeholders.

Title: Chief Operating Officer
Description:
Syntys is a leading digital infrastructure platform specializing in the design, development, and operation of carrier-neutral data centers across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). With an established and expanding network of facilities across strategic markets, Syntys delivers secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure for hyperscalers, AI clusters, and wholesale colocation providers. Through purpose-built facilities and build-to-suit solutions, Syntys supports the growing demand for cloud, AI, and advanced computing infrastructure, enabling the continued growth of the digital economy.

We are seeking a seasoned and results-driven
**Chief Operating Officer (COO)**
to provide strategic and executive leadership across our data center operations, with enterprise-wide accountability for operational excellence, mission-critical infrastructure availability, reliability, resilience, scalability, customer commitments, and service delivery.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO will play a pivotal role in translating Syntys’ ambitious growth strategy into scalable operational capabilities, building a high-performing organization, and ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of our data center platform.

The role encompasses executive leadership and oversight of Data Center Operations, Critical Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) Infrastructure, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability, ensuring integrated governance, operational resilience, and consistent performance across all markets.

The COO will be instrumental in enabling business growth and delivering world-class operational standards to meet the demanding requirements of hyperscale cloud providers, AI infrastructure customers, GPU-intensive computing environments, and wholesale colocation clients.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Enterprise Operations & Strategic Leadership:**
  Develop and execute the enterprise-wide operations strategy, establishing scalable, standardized, and performance-driven operating models across all markets and facilities.
* **Mission-Critical Infrastructure & Engineering Operations:**
  Oversee mission-critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, power, fire protection, and facilities infrastructure, ensuring availability, reliability, uptime, and maintenance excellence. Ensure commissioning acceptance, integrated systems testing, and seamless transition from construction and project delivery into live operations.
* **Hyperscale & AI Infrastructure:**
  Drive operational readiness for hyperscale cloud, AI training, AI inference, and high-performance computing environments, including high-density power requirements, GPU infrastructure, advanced liquid cooling technologies, large-scale customer deployments, and phased capacity activation.
* **Executive Oversight of Operational Functions:**
  Provide executive oversight across headquarters and market operations, Critical Facilities Operations (Mechanical & Electrical), Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management (FM), Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability.
* **Operational Governance, Risk & Compliance:**
  Establish operational governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and controls across all facilities. Oversee incident management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, business continuity, disaster recovery, emergency response, crisis management, operational audits, risk assessments, regulatory compliance, Operational Technology (OT) Security, cybersecurity resilience, and third-party operator and contractor performance. Ensure adherence to applicable industry standards and data center frameworks, including Uptime Institute Tier standards and relevant ISO standards.
* **Customer Experience & Strategic Account Management:**
  Ensure delivery against contractual obligations, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and customer-specific requirements. Act as the senior executive escalation point for major operational incidents and customer concerns. Lead operational business reviews and support commercial growth through operational assurance and executive-level customer engagement.
* **Financial Performance, Asset Management & Sustainability:**
  Own operational expenditure (OPEX) performance and contribute to capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning and investment prioritization. Drive cost optimization, asset lifecycle management, operational productivity, procurement effectiveness, vendor performance, budgeting, and financial forecasting. Lead energy efficiency, carbon reduction, resource optimization, and sustainability initiatives, including Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE).
* **Leadership, Organization & Talent Development:**
  Build and lead high-performing operations teams, establish clear organizational structures and leadership accountability, and drive succession planning, talent development, retention, and performance management. Foster a culture of ownership, operational discipline, safety, customer focus, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline. A Master's degree or relevant professional certifications are advantageous.
* **Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience**
  , including significant senior leadership experience in data center operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or critical facilities environments.
* Proven track record of leading
  **large-scale, multi-site or geographically distributed data center operations**
  , preferably at COO, SVP Operations, or equivalent senior leadership level.
* Solid experience managing
  **hyperscaler, cloud service provider, and strategic customer relationships**
  , with a strong understanding of contractual commitments, SLAs, and service delivery expectations.
* Strong technical expertise in
  **mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure**
  , including power systems, cooling technologies, maintenance strategies, operational reliability, and resilience.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing key operational functions, including
  **Data Center Operations, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, IT, and Cybersecurity**
  , with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage operational interdependencies.
* Proven ability to manage
  **operational risks, critical incidents, business continuity, and crisis situations**
  , demonstrating sound judgment, accountability, and effective decision-making under pressure.
* Strong
  **commercial and financial acumen**
  , including operational budgeting, cost optimization, asset management, and vendor performance management.
* Demonstrated ability to
  **build and develop high-performing teams, strengthen operational governance, and scale operations**
  in a growing, multi-market business environment.
* Exposure to
  **AI infrastructure, high-density computing, GPU environments, and advanced cooling technologies**
  is highly desirable.

**Job Description:**

This role will lead the architecture of enterprise ServiceNow Security Operations solutions that connect security, technology, risk, and remediation teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Security Operations Architecture - Define end-to-end architectures, design patterns, guardrails, and roadmaps for ServiceNow Security Operations, including USEM, SIR, VR, Security Posture Control, Threat Intelligence Security Center, Major Security Incident Management, and Data Loss Prevention Incident Response.

Design risk-based prioritization, exposure scoring, asset and business-context enrichment, remediation ownership, exception handling, and executive reporting.
* Vulnerability Response - Design VR solutions for vulnerable item ingestion, matching, grouping, assignment, remediation-task creation, target rules, exceptions, false positives, SLAs, and closed-loop remediation. Cover infrastructure, Application Vulnerability Response, Container Vulnerability Response, cloud and operational technology use cases where in scope.
* Security Incident Response -
* Design the security incident lifecycle from intake and enrichment through triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, post-incident review, and knowledge capture. Establish playbooks, response templates, evidence handling, case privacy, role separation, and major-incident patterns.
* Integrations & Security Data -
* Lead integrations with vulnerability scanners, CNAPP/CSPM platforms, SIEM/SOAR, EDR/XDR, threat-intelligence platforms, code and container scanners, CMDB/Discovery, DevSecOps toolchains, and enterprise data sources using IntegrationHub, spokes, APIs, MID Servers, import sets, transform maps, and event-driven patterns.
* CMDB, CSDM & Asset Context - Ensure security findings and incidents are reliably associated to authoritative configuration items, applications, services, owners, locations, and criticality. Define reconciliation, identification, normalization, data-quality controls, and handling for unmatched or stale assets.
* Technical Governance - Own architecture decisions, non-functional requirements, access controls, data segregation, encryption considerations, retention, auditability, performance, upgrade readiness, and technical debt. Roadmap & Product Partnership - Partner with Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, Application Security, Cloud Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, and ServiceNow platform leadership to define a multi-year capability roadmap and measurable outcomes.

Excellent executive communication, workshop facilitation, architecture documentation, decision-making, and stakeholder-management skills across cyber, technology, risk, audit, and operations teams.

* Identify needs, technology, space requirements, equipment requirements and services; and provide cost estimate and implementation plans
* Coordinate the timely delivery of materials and services in accordance with section projects
* Forecast future material needs, plan inventory levels and establish safety stock to ensure that adequate stock levels are maintained
* Identify and analyze slow moving and obsolete material, and take appropriate action
* Prepare budgetary requirements by determining quantities, labour hours and costs
* Investigate and report on cost variances, and provide recommendations

Title: Cybersecurity Consultant
Description:
**Location:** Doha, Qatar

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Consultant to deliver both hands-on security operations and expert advisory services to the organization and its clients. The role combines security monitoring, detection, incident response, threat analysis, and vulnerability coordination with cybersecurity consultancy, including security assessments, risk and compliance advisory, security architecture, and strategic roadmap development. The successful candidate will have strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity, SIEM, EDR/XDR, network security, identity security, cloud security, threat intelligence, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC).

This role will support and strengthen security operations capabilities, lead complex security incidents and assessments, translate technical findings into clear business-focused recommendations, and work closely with clients, Infrastructure, Development, IT Operations, and management to reduce cyber risk, achieve regulatory compliance, and improve overall security maturity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. SOC Operations & Security Monitoring:

· Support and, where required, lead day-to-day SOC operations, ensuring continuous monitoring, alert triage, investigation, escalation, and response.

· Design, establish, and maintain SOC processes, operating procedures, runbooks, escalation paths, and shift models for the organization and its clients.

· Monitor security events across endpoints, servers, networks, identity platforms, cloud environments, applications, and security appliances.

· Ensure security alerts are investigated within defined priorities and response targets, with appropriate evidence and documentation.

· Continuously improve SOC workflows to reduce false positives, improve alert quality, and increase analyst efficiency.

2. SIEM, EDR/XDR & Security Tooling:

· Design, implement, and optimize SIEM operations, including log onboarding, normalization, correlation rules, dashboards, alerting, and retention.

· Configure and optimize EDR/XDR capabilities for endpoint detection, investigation, containment, and response.

· Ensure appropriate security telemetry is collected from firewalls, network devices, servers, applications, cloud platforms, identity services, and critical systems.

· Evaluate security tooling and provide vendor-neutral recommendations to improve detection, investigation, automation, and response capabilities.

· Develop and maintain security monitoring use cases aligned with business risks, threat intelligence, and emerging attack techniques.

3. Incident Response & Threat Management:

· Lead the investigation and response to high-severity cybersecurity incidents, including malware, ransomware, phishing, account compromise, data exfiltration, and unauthorized access.

· Coordinate containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident activities with technical teams, business stakeholders, and client representatives.

· Lead root-cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are identified, tracked, and completed.

· Develop, maintain, and facilitate testing of incident response plans, playbooks, and tabletop exercises.

· Support digital forensics and evidence preservation activities, engaging specialist resources when required.

4. Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting:

· Establish threat intelligence processes to identify relevant threats, indicators of compromise, vulnerabilities, and attacker tactics.

· Lead proactive threat hunting across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and SIEM data sources.

· Develop and tune detection rules, correlation logic, queries, and use cases based on MITRE ATT&CK and observed threats.

· Translate threat intelligence into actionable monitoring, detection, and advisory recommendations.

· Track emerging threats and assess their potential impact on the organization's and clients' technology environments.

5. Vulnerability & Security Exposure Management:

· Coordinate vulnerability monitoring and remediation activities with Infrastructure, Systems, Network, Application, and Cloud teams.

· Review vulnerability findings, prioritize remediation based on risk, and monitor closure of critical and high-risk issues.

· Monitor external attack surface, exposed services, misconfigurations, and security weaknesses.

· Plan, scope, and support penetration testing, security assessments, and remediation validation activities.

6. Cloud, Network & Infrastructure Security:

· Provide security oversight and advisory across Azure, Google Cloud, on-premises data centers, enterprise networks, servers, endpoints, and identity environments.

· Demonstrate strong understanding of firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, network segmentation, DNS, secure remote access, and network traffic analysis.

· Monitor cloud security events, IAM activity, privileged access, configuration risks, and security controls.

· Recommend and support hardening, patching, segmentation, MFA, privileged access, and secure configuration baselines.

7. Cybersecurity Consultancy & Advisory Services:

· Act as a trusted cybersecurity advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, providing expert guidance on security strategy, risk, and technology decisions.

· Lead consulting engagements end-to-end, including scoping, planning, stakeholder interviews, fieldwork, analysis, reporting, and close-out.

· Develop cybersecurity strategies, target operating models, and multi-year security roadmaps aligned with business objectives.

· Translate complex technical findings into clear, prioritized, and business-focused recommendations for executives and technical teams.

· Manage engagement timelines, deliverables, quality, and client expectations to ensure successful outcomes.

8. Security Assessments & Maturity Reviews:

· Conduct cybersecurity maturity assessments, gap analyses, and control reviews against recognized frameworks and regulatory requirements.

· Perform security architecture reviews, configuration reviews, and SOC capability and readiness assessments.

· Assess cloud, network, identity, endpoint, and application security posture and identify improvement opportunities.

· Prepare high-quality assessment reports, risk registers, executive summaries, and remediation plans.

9. Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC):

· Advise on and support the implementation of security frameworks and standards, including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and applicable national and sector regulations (e.g., Qatar NIA / NCSA requirements).

· Develop and review cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.

· Perform cybersecurity risk assessments, including risk identification, analysis, treatment planning, and tracking.

· Support internal and external audits, certification readiness, and compliance evidence preparation.

· Advise on third-party and supply chain security risk, data protection, and business continuity considerations.

10. Security Architecture & Solution Design:

· Design secure architectures and security solutions for on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

· Define security requirements and controls for new projects, solutions, and digital transformation initiatives.

· Apply security-by-design, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles across infrastructure, identity, and applications.

· Review and validate solution designs, implementation plans, and security configurations prior to deployment.

11. Pre-Sales, Proposals & Client Engagement:

· Support business development by understanding client requirements and designing appropriate cybersecurity service offerings.

· Prepare technical proposals, solution designs, scopes of work, effort estimates, and responses to RFPs/RFQs.

· Deliver client presentations, workshops, and solution demonstrations.

· Build and maintain strong long-term client relationships and identify opportunities for additional value-added services.

12. Knowledge Transfer, Reporting & Continuous Improvement:

· Define security KPIs and metrics covering alert volumes, response times, incident severity, detection effectiveness, SLA performance, risk posture, and remediation progress.

· Prepare regular security operations, risk, and engagement reports for senior management and clients.

· Mentor SOC analysts and engineers, and deliver knowledge transfer, training, and security awareness sessions.

· Drive automation and orchestration of repetitive security activities using SOAR, scripting, APIs, or equivalent technologies.

· Contribute to the development of internal methodologies, templates, toolkits, and service offerings.

**Required Qualifications:**

· Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

· 7+ years of cybersecurity experience, including significant hands-on experience in SOC operations, security monitoring, incident response, or security engineering.

· Demonstrated experience delivering cybersecurity consulting engagements, assessments, or advisory services in enterprise or client-facing environments.

· Strong hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, Elastic, or equivalent.

· Strong experience with EDR/XDR platforms such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or equivalent.

· Strong understanding of network security including firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, segmentation, TCP/IP, DNS, proxy technologies, and network traffic analysis.

· Strong understanding of Windows and Linux security, Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, authentication, privileged access, and endpoint security.

· Hands-on experience with cloud security architecture, monitoring, and incident response in Azure and/or Google Cloud environments.

· Strong knowledge of incident response lifecycle, threat hunting, vulnerability management, and security investigation techniques.

· Experience with MITRE ATT&CK, threat intelligence, IOC analysis, and detection use case development.

· Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and relevant national regulations (e.g., Qatar NIA).

· Proven experience conducting risk assessments, gap analyses, maturity assessments, and developing security policies and roadmaps.

· Experience preparing technical proposals, assessment reports, and executive-level presentations.

· Working knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or equivalent.

**Preferred Certifications:**

· CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional.

· CISM – Certified Information Security Manager, or CISA – Certified Information Systems Auditor.

· ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.

· GIAC certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, or GSTRT are an advantage.

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200) or Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100) is an advantage.

· Cloud security certifications such as CCSP, AZ-500, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer are an advantage.

· Offensive security certifications such as OSCP or CEH are an advantage.

**Preferred Skills:**

· Strong consulting mindset with a client-focused, solution-oriented, and advisory approach.

· Excellent incident investigation, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

· Able to lead high-severity security incidents and client engagements calmly and effectively under pressure.

· Strong technical understanding across network, systems, endpoint, identity, application, and cloud security.

· Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex security risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives.

· Strong report writing, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

· Able to manage multiple engagements and priorities while maintaining high quality standards.

· Fluency in English is required; Arabic is an advantage.

Title: Transport Coordinator
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Join our Transport Services team, where you will play a key role in managing and optimizing our fleet and transportation operations. The team is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and on-time performance through quality control, route management, transport assessments, and continuous improvements our transportation standards.

If you are passionate about logistics, operational efficiency, and upholding the highest health and safety standards, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As part of the world’s largest international airline, our transport services team is essential in keeping our operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

As a **Transport Coordinator** , you will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) throughout the entire vehicle lifecycle, from inception to disposal, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with all system requirements. Generate reports and maintain comprehensive records of vehicle-related costs, monitor expenditures, reconcile pending issues, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies. Coordinate application upgrades and system enhancements in line with operational requirements to improve efficiency. Liaise with vehicle users to identify and assess repair requirements based on reported non-technical information, conduct preliminary assessments, and assist senior management in establishing higher repair standards by recommending effective and economical solutions. Ensure efficient coordination of vehicle maintenance and repairs while maintaining cost control and optimal fleet performance.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain accurate and comprehensive vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) from inception to disposal. Records include vehicle specifications, user details, registration, insurance, and fuel card information. Exercise utmost care when entering technical data, as certain information cannot be amended once entered.
* Arrange repair appointments, prepare Repair Request Forms (RRFs) using appropriate technical terminology, coordinate drivers for vehicle delivery, and arrange collection upon completion of repairs. Ensure effective scheduling to minimise delays and allow sufficient time for repairs.
* Assist in inspecting vehicles and identifying technical faults within the Central Services fleet. Interpret reported problems from users who may lack technical knowledge and translate them into accurate automotive terminology to facilitate effective repairs while saving time and costs.
* Liaise with workshops to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective repairs. Obtain repair estimates and approvals from user departments, communicate approvals to workshops, follow up on repair progress, and ensure all relevant transactions are updated in CSTMS.
* Ensure timely collection and accurate uploading of workshop and agency invoices into CSTMS. Coordinate with IT and workshops to resolve data errors during invoice downloads, ensuring complete reconciliation with corresponding RRFs. Manually process invoices received from agencies and other garages on an invoice-by-invoice basis.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding vehicle registration renewals, Traffic Department repair recommendations, accident-related repairs, and settlement of fines. Liaise with insurance companies, tyre suppliers, and EPPCO for insurance-related matters, tyre requirements, and fuel card issuance or cancellation.
* Assist senior management in preparing exception reports, analysing data, preparing case notes, and communicating findings. Monitor registration renewals, fuel card issuance, quotations, invoice verification, and CSTMS records to prevent overcharging and ensure cost-effective repairs and quality workmanship.
* Maintain comprehensive records of vehicle servicing, registration, insurance documents, invoices, accident reports, and other vehicle-related correspondence. Ensure timely communication of company vehicle user details to HR, Management Accounts, and Payroll.
* Provide technical guidance to user departments and workshops, as required, to ensure repairs meet the required standards. Advise vehicle users on appropriate vehicle care following major repairs, including engine and air-conditioning system overhauls.
* Prepare vehicle handover and takeover checklists, conduct random inspections of the Central Services fleet, and prepare snag lists. In the absence of available resources, arrange or personally undertake vehicle delivery and collection to and from workshops or senior managers' residences, as required.

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Have completed 12 years of schooling or equivalent.
Have at least 5 years of experience working in Supply Chain, Logistics or Transport.  

  

**You will have an edge if you have:**

* Have experience working with Resource Management Systems (RMS), Real-Time Control (RTC), Multi-Access Check-in System.
* Have experience working with Microsoft Office Applications.

**About TRCA:**  
With more than 60 years of experience, Toronto and Region Conservation Authority (TRCA) is one of 36 Conservation Authorities in Ontario, created to safeguard and enhance the health and well-being of watershed communities through the protection and restoration of the natural environment and the ecological services the environment provides.
  
  
TRCA is considered the provincial leader in conserving, restoring, and managing natural resources to advance safe and sustainable development. Also, TRCA was recently recognized as a Greater Toronto’s Top Employer for 2026 and a Canada’s Greenest Employer for 2026.

The Education Interpreter delivers hands-on environmental and nature programs to visitors and visitor groups at Tommy Thompson Park. The Education Interpreter also conducts daily park inspections and assists with visitor emergencies, and plays an active role in customer experience ensuring all visitors have a positive experience. The Education Interpreter is comfortable working in a small team, under minimal supervision. Education Interpreters typically work in teams of two on weekends (Saturday and Sunday and holidays, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m./4:30 p.m. (summer/winter)) every other weekend, however, the schedule is flexible and based on staff availability. This is an occasional contract position in the environmental field.

* Conducts site inspections to identify any major hazards, incidents and issues.
* Addresses injuries and incidents at the park.
* Learns program content to be able to effectively deliver interactive programs to various audiences.
* Ensures program equipment/supplies including artifacts are well maintained, clean and stored appropriately.
* Provides support in program development and administrative tasks as required.
* Incumbents may also be assigned other duties.

Education (degree/diploma/certifications/licenses)
  

* Minimum pursuing a post-secondary diploma or degree in a related field
* Valid Standard First Aid & CPR/AED Level C Certification
* Valid Ontario Class G2 driver's license

Knowledge/Skill/Ability - Competencies
  

* Understanding of Tommy Thompson Park and the area’s flora and fauna.
* Ability to deliver programs/information to audiences of various ages, adapting style to ensure audience appropriateness.
* Ability to communicate effectively with tact and courtesy.
* Experience interacting and connecting with persons of various social, cultural, or economic backgrounds; at ease with a variety of audiences.
* Strong communication skills to provide clear and concise communication in both non-emergency and emergency situations.
* Able to self-manage workload and prioritize tasks independently.
* Demonstrates responsiveness to internal and external customer requests and needs.
* Able to comprehend written documentation and procedural guidelines.
* Must be flexible to work all required shifts, including weekends and holidays.

**What TRCA has to offer you:**  
As part of a progressive team you will have the opportunity to make a positive impact to preserving and protecting nature, while maintaining a balance between the natural environment and built environment. Working with experts within our field, you will join a team of colleagues that are committed to TRCA’s core values by demonstrating the following behaviours; integrity, collaboration, accountability, respect, and excellence (icare).

* Offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits program (including Defined Benefit Pension Plan – OMERS/OTPP).
* Pregnancy & Parental Leave Top-Up Program.

* Offers potential for career growth and advancement.
