Title: Senior Systems Engineer - Enterprise Services
Description:
The Senior Systems Engineer – Enterprise Services is responsible for the administration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based technology solutions across ZainTECH's customer environments. The role ensures the availability, performance, security, and reliability of critical infrastructure services while providing advanced technical support and maintaining operational standards in accordance with customer requirements and industry best practices.

Working closely with customers, technical delivery teams, Project Managers, and other infrastructure specialists, the Senior Systems Engineer supports the full lifecycle of enterprise infrastructure solutions, including deployment, configuration, migration, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance. The role also contributes to infrastructure improvements, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer to ensure effective service delivery and long-term operational stability.

Responsibilities:

Enterprise Infrastructure Administration & Operations

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based systems across customer environments.
* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly operational activities to ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of critical infrastructure services.
* Monitor system health, capacity, and performance, proactively identifying and addressing potential operational issues.
* Implement and maintain system configurations, security controls, and operational procedures in accordance with established best practices.
* Support the administration of enterprise infrastructure services, ensuring secure and reliable access for authorized users.
* Perform preventive maintenance, system updates, and routine operational checks to minimize service disruptions.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

* Provide advanced technical support to enterprise customers through on-site and remote troubleshooting.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve infrastructure incidents, system failures, and performance-related issues.
* Support major customer accounts through proactive technical engagement, issue resolution, and ongoing service improvement.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including Active Directory, Exchange Server, Microsoft 365, virtualization, and cloud services.
* Escalate complex technical issues to relevant specialists or vendors where required, ensuring appropriate follow-up and resolution.
* Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to customer IT teams to support effective system administration and operational continuity.

Infrastructure Implementation & Migration

* Install, configure, deploy, and integrate enterprise infrastructure solutions in accordance with approved technical designs and customer requirements.
* Implement Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including identity services, messaging platforms, virtualization, and cloud-based solutions.
* Support and supervise infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and system modernization activities while minimizing disruption to customer operations.
* Configure and optimize infrastructure environments to meet performance, availability, and security requirements.
* Coordinate implementation activities with Project Managers, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
* Validate infrastructure configurations and ensure deployed solutions meet agreed technical specifications and operational requirements.

Microsoft Cloud & Enterprise Services

* Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, identity management, authentication, and access control solutions.
* Support Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and associated collaboration technologies.
* Configure and maintain Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization environments and related infrastructure services.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Azure AD Connect, Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
* Administer Microsoft Azure infrastructure services, including virtual machines, virtual networks, storage accounts, and related cloud resources.
* Support Microsoft Intune, information protection, and enterprise mobility and security capabilities.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery solutions using Microsoft Azure and associated technologies.

Testing, Documentation & Reporting

* Perform system integration testing, configuration validation, and operational readiness assessments for implemented solutions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, implementation records, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
* Document infrastructure changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure accurate technical records.
* Provide regular technical status updates and progress reports to Project Managers, supervisors, and relevant stakeholders.
* Communicate incidents, technical risks, and operational issues clearly, escalating matters requiring management attention.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance infrastructure performance, security, and service delivery quality.

*Our Culture & Code of Conduct:*

*At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. We are looking for individuals who share these values and are committed to customer-centricity and ethical excellence. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from ho we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally.*

 **Requirements**

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 4–6 years of experience in Microsoft infrastructure administration, enterprise systems engineering, or related IT infrastructure roles.
* Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, including user management, authentication, and directory services.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and related collaboration platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization technologies.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) and hybrid identity environments.
* Experience configuring and supporting Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Microsoft System Center products and enterprise infrastructure management technologies.
* Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, including:
* + Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, and related infrastructure services.
  + Identity & Access Management: Microsoft Entra ID, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Azure AD Connect.
  + Enterprise Mobility & Security: Microsoft Intune, Azure Rights Management, and associated security capabilities.
  + Monitoring & Operations: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related infrastructure monitoring services.
  + Backup & Disaster Recovery: Azure Site Recovery and Azure Backup.
* Experience supporting infrastructure implementation, system upgrades, migrations, and technical troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of enterprise infrastructure security, system availability, performance optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong technical documentation and reporting skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic.
* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Coordinator, VOD, Global Product Delivery

The role coordinates materials, delivery requests, platform refreshes, project tracking and quality-control follow-up, helping ensure content and supporting assets are complete, accurate and delivered on schedule.
  
This new role supports active projects, takes on overflow work and coordinates smaller projects with established requirements and timelines. The role works closely with Technical Media Services, Creative, Content Operations and external partners to keep assigned tasks moving and flag issues requiring support.
  
This role will report to the Senior Manager, VOD, Global Product Delivery and is a hybrid position requiring in-office attendance at our head office in Toronto for a minimum of three (3) days per week.
  
The anticipated salary range for this role is $50,000 – $55,000 per year, with final compensation determined by experience and qualifications.
  
Core Responsibilities & Duties
  
VOD Delivery and Platform Support
  

* Support any changes needed to office space, office moves, the movement of furniture and equipment, and other facility projects.
* Maintain general condition and cleanliness of both onsite and offsite storage spaces, including loading/offloading before and after trade shows.
* Maintain good working relationships with external contactors and monitor the completion of work as required in accordance with contracts, corporate policies, legislated requirements, holding vendors accountable, and addressing issues when they arise.
* Support scheduled content refreshes, platform launches and ongoing deliveries across assigned VOD platforms. (including BAR international deliveries as needed)
* Gather and organize video, artwork, metadata, captions and other required materials.
* Create and update delivery requests, tickets, schedules and trackers using established workflows.
* Communicate confirmed requirements, deadlines and status updates to internal teams and external partners.
* Follow up on missing materials and outstanding tasks, flagging delays or issues to the Supervisor or Senior Manager.
* Provide additional delivery support during busy periods and take on overflow tasks within priorities set by the Senior Manager.

Smaller Project Coordination
  

* Coordinate assigned smaller VOD projects or routine refreshes within agreed scope, requirements and timelines.
* Track deliverables, follow up with contributors and maintain accurate project status.
* Handle routine project communication and resolve straightforward issues using established processes.
* Seek guidance when requirements change, deadlines are at risk or an issue falls outside the agreed scope.
* Support larger projects by completing assigned tasks and coordinating specific deliverables.

Third-Party Delivery Support

* Prepare and coordinate platform-specific materials, including editorial forms, artwork and metadata.
* Support onboarding tasks for new platforms and territories.
* Log platform rejections, gather supporting information and coordinate follow-up with the appropriate teams.
* Track corrections and redelivery requests through completion.

Artwork Coordination
  

* Locate, gather and request artwork based on confirmed platform requirements.
* Submit and track Creative requests through Wrike.
* Follow up on artwork approvals, missing assets and outstanding deliverables.
* Check artwork against established specifications and flag gaps or issues for resolution.

Quality-Control Follow-Up
  

* Monitor delivery flags and QC/QA reports for assigned platforms and projects.
* Coordinate follow-up with Delivery Coordinators to address identified issues.
* Track corrections through resubmission and platform acceptance as needed.
* Escalate recurring, complex or time-sensitive issues to the Supervisor or Senior Manager.

Asset and Workflow Support
  

* Conduct routine asset checks and audits, including artwork and caption availability.
* Maintain accurate project, platform and delivery information in Airtable.
* Keep tickets, trackers and internal records current, with clear next steps.
* Help maintain workflow documentation and flag opportunities to simplify recurring tasks.
* Assist with other VOD operational priorities as assigned.

Key Qualifications and Experience
  

* Two or more years of experience in VOD, streaming, digital media, content operations, broadcast operations or a related area.
* Experience supporting content deliveries, platform refreshes or digital-platform launches is preferred.
* Familiarity with video assets, metadata, artwork, captions and platform delivery requirements.
* Experience coordinating materials with external vendors; exposure to localization workflows is an asset.
* Experience with tools such as Airtable and Wrike is an asset.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Reliable follow-through and the ability to identify missing information, troubleshoot routine issues and keep work moving.

Title: Customer Delivery Software Architect

Cisco Customer Experience (CX) is seeking a Customer Delivery Software Architect to lead the design and delivery of automation and AI-enabled solutions for a major service provider in Saudi Arabia.
  
  
You will define scalable software architectures that connect network infrastructure, operational systems, data platforms, and business workflows. Working with customer stakeholders and cross-functional Cisco teams, you will translate complex operational needs into secure, reusable, and maintainable solutions.
  
  
This is a software architecture role—not a network migration or product implementation role. Its primary focus is establishing sound architecture, engineering practices, integration patterns, and governance for network automation and intelligent operations.
  
  
Frequent onsite collaboration in Riyadh is required due to customer access controls, local testing requirements, and the need to work closely with engineering and operations teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end software architecture for network automation, orchestration, assurance, observability, and AI-enabled operational solutions.
* Translate business and operational requirements into architecture blueprints, technical roadmaps, integration patterns, data models, APIs, and engineering backlogs.
* Design secure, modular, scalable solutions integrating network platforms with systems such as Cisco Crosswork.
* Establish engineering standards covering source control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, release management, security, and software lifecycle governance.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design and delivery, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring implementations meet functional and non-functional requirements.
* Leads and influences global, cross-functional teams—including PMs, PgMs, SDMs, CEs, TLs, and customer stakeholders—to ensure successful delivery of complex, multi-architecture solutions aligned to business outcomes
* Define practical approaches for applying AI and analytics to use cases such as anomaly detection, operational insight, decision support, and workflow automation.
* Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices while mentoring engineers and strengthening software architecture capabilities across delivery teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 12 or more years of relevant experience; master’s degree with 8 or more years; PhD with 5 or more years; or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade software, automation, orchestration, or systems-integration solutions.
* Strong proficiency in software architecture principles, distributed systems, API design, event-driven architectures, data modelling, and integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with Python or a comparable programming language, APIs, Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and modern development practices.
* Experience architecting solutions that integrate network infrastructure, operational platforms, telemetry, data, and business workflows.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and their practical application to automation, analytics, and operational use cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional engineering teams and communicate effectively with tech.hnical and executive stakeholders.
* Experience with Cisco NSO or comparable orchestration platforms, including service modelling, lifecycle management, device integration and reusable automation components.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in telecommunications, service-provider, or other large-scale, mission-critical environments.
* Knowledge of network orchestration, assurance, observability, and automation platforms, including Cisco Crosswork.
* Experience establishing engineering governance and reusable automation frameworks across multiple teams.
* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, streaming technologies, data platforms, and AIOps.
* Understanding of responsible AI, data governance, model lifecycle management, and security-by-design.
* Experience mentoring software engineers and helping organizations adopt modern software-engineering practices.
* Nature of work: Onsite Full time
* Hours of work: 48 hours per week
* Benefits: Healthcare and Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase program, Flexible Spending Benefit, Flex and Schooling Allowances and many more.
* Application start and end date: 27th October for 4-5 weeks

This role will shape the software foundations for scalable network automation and intelligent operations. The successful candidate will combine architecture leadership with practical engineering expertise, helping transform automation into secure, reusable capabilities that deliver sustained operational value.

Title: Network Engineer

* Familiarity with Cisco Prime Infrastructure 3.7 and PRTG Network Monitor.
* Experience with Cisco Firepower 5508 and Fortinet FortiGate firewalls (1000-D, 501E, and 60E).
* Strong troubleshooting, network security, and infrastructure management skills.
* Excellent documentation, reporting, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and under pressure.

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with experience in enterprise data environments and complex technology change. They are comfortable working across business stakeholders, data engineering, software, governance, and data quality teams to clarify needs, manage requirements and delivery processes, and help lead large-scale migration work while supporting the continuity of existing data services.

**The Role**

  

As a Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration, you will serve as a primary interface between stakeholders across GM Canada and the internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery priorities, processes, and documentation that enable teams to maintain the existing enterprise data environment and deliver its migration to a cloud-based implementation.

This role combines business analysis, delivery coordination, and change management responsibilities. You will manage requirements and documentation, support process definition and improvement, facilitate sprint planning and backlog activities, and coordinate stakeholders through complex, interdependent work. You will play a critical role in migration planning and execution, helping teams assess impacts, manage dependencies and risks, validate outcomes, and maintain business continuity. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Act as the primary point of contact and day-to-day interface between GM Canada stakeholders and internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams.
* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, data, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and delivery priorities.
* Coordinate discovery of the existing enterprise data environment, including business processes, data flows, interfaces, dependencies, consumers, controls, and operational procedures.
* Support the ongoing operation of the legacy enterprise data environment while coordinating enhancements, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.
* Help lead large-scale, complex migration efforts by coordinating business and technical workstreams, requirements, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, and readiness activities.
* Work with technical teams to assess the business and operational impacts of migrating data, processes, interfaces, reports, and downstream consumers to a cloud-based environment.
* Facilitate requirements traceability from business needs through design, development, testing, release, and post-implementation validation.
* Coordinate data validation, reconciliation, business acceptance, and sign-off activities to confirm migrated data and capabilities meet business needs.
* Create, maintain, and manage project and operational documentation, including requirements, process maps, decision logs, data definitions, meeting outcomes, test scenarios, release materials, and user guidance.
* Define and improve processes, workflows, roles, and handoffs across business and technical teams, including processes for data quality, governance, issue management, and change delivery.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, demos, and retrospectives in partnership with product owners and delivery teams.
* Track progress, milestones, actions, decisions, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies; communicate status and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support data governance and data quality practices by coordinating ownership, definitions, standards, controls, issue resolution, and business approvals.
* Coordinate stakeholder engagement and change readiness, ensuring affected teams understand upcoming changes, impacts, timelines, and required actions.
* Collaborate with data architects, engineers, developers, analytics teams, product owners, and business partners to ensure proposed solutions align with business outcomes and enterprise standards.
Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery practices, documentation standards, stakeholder communications, and operational processes.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Project Analyst, or in a similar role supporting data, software, technology, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience working with data platforms, data warehouses, databases, reporting, data integration, or related enterprise technology.
* Experience supporting complex technology change, migration, modernization, or transformation initiatives, including coordination across multiple teams and dependencies.
* Strong documentation skills, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, meeting outcomes, decisions, and status reporting.
* Experience supporting Agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, estimation, and delivery tracking.
* Ability to understand and communicate data flows, interfaces, system dependencies, business processes, and impacts across upstream and downstream teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, clarify ambiguity, assess impacts, and organize complex information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for business and technical audiences.
* Strong facilitation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align teams with differing priorities.
* Proficiency with collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence, or comparable tools.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and priorities.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting enterprise data warehouse or data platform migrations, particularly from on-premises Oracle environments to cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud data and analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting large-scale or complex migrations involving data, ETL/ELT processes, reports, interfaces, or downstream consumers.
* Experience with data governance, data quality management, metadata, data cataloging, lineage, or master/reference data practices.
* Experience defining migration approach, scope, business impacts, dependencies, readiness criteria, and validation or reconciliation plans.
* Familiarity with SQL and the ability to review queries, data structures, mappings, and reconciliation results.
* Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, defect triage, business sign-off, and post-release validation.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed, or regulated organization with formal security, privacy, risk, or change-management practices.
Familiarity with tools such as Lucidchart, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, or equivalent requirements and process-mapping tools.  

**Compensation:**

The salary range for this role is $97,800 to $146,600. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Operator
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Operator in Doha, Qatar.**

An Operator is an integral member of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC). Under the direction and guidance of the GSOC Manager and GSOC Supervisor, the GSOC Operator will be tasked with the delivery of high-quality security risk monitoring, advice and the coordination of security assistance services on a profile and itinerary-specific basis to travellers, international assignees, domestic nationals, and QatarEnergy risk managers.

The GSOC Operator will contribute to operational readiness by carrying out tasking to maintain and develop the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

The GSOC Operator is responsible for providing the delivery of professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy to the highest standards of excellence and will also be tasked with intelligence collection, processing, and analysis to provide timely security assessments and advice to QatarEnergy’s Security Team and internal stakeholders, through primarily, but not exclusively, written reports, as required.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Deliver high-quality, bespoke, verbal and written security risk assessments tailored to a QatarEnergy Business and Operations profile and itinerary, escalating to the GSOC Supervisor as required.
* Under the guidance of the GSOC Supervisor, coordinate and oversee responses to security requests for assistance, including the production of Plans of Action (POA) for specific Requests for Assistance (RFAs), as required.
* Set up, coordinate and monitor tracking tasks using GPS and communication with clients travelling in complex working environments.
* Contribute to operational readiness by supporting the maintenance and development of the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.
* Deliver professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy, ensuring the highest standards of quality and service.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Conduct continuous monitoring of global security environments and risk indicators.
* Track geopolitical developments, terrorism, civil unrest, natural hazards and other emerging threats.
* Collect, process and analyse intelligence to support timely security assessments and reporting.
* Escalate identified threats in accordance with established SOPs and guidance from supervisors.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Provide support to pre-travel security requirements, including responding to traveller queries and delivering itinerary-specific advice.
* Monitor live travel movements of personnel and maintain situational awareness.
* Coordinate with approved security and medical assistance providers to facilitate support.
* Track and document incidents involving travellers, ensuring accurate reporting and timely updates.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management Support**

  

* Support GSOC monitoring activities during incidents, crises and emergencies.
* Log, update and maintain accurate incident records and case documentation.
* Assist in information dissemination to relevant stakeholders as directed.
* Ensure proper case handover between shifts, maintaining continuity of operations.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of the political and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex situations to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of information under time pressure.
* Demonstrated experience in the application of risk assessments.
* Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in security intelligence or related fields such as military, government, NGO, journalism; relevant academic studies.
* Independent travel experience to multiple countries, including more challenging risk environments.

  ###
* ### **Preferred Experience**

  + Risk and Crisis Management experience.
  + Experience in writing to senior management and decision-makers.
  + International work experience, including in more challenging risk environments.
  + Experience of working in a customer/client-focused role.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or relevant professional training) in a field related to security, risk management, international politics or international relations.
* Master’s degree in similar fields an advantage.

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Other language (Arabic, French, etc.) proficiency desirable.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor in Doha, Qatar.**

A prominent member of the GSOC, the Supervisor will act as a go-to-person for the Security Operator and will report to the GSOC Manager.

The GSOC Supervisor will review and monitor the tasks of the GSOC Operator and provide necessary guidance and support, as required by the GSOC Operator. The GSOC Supervisor will facilitate the timely delivery of high-quality security risk advice, will communicate with different internal stakeholders and will incorporate feedback from QatarEnergy into the day-to-day operations of the GSOC.

The GSOC Supervisor will also support security assessments relating to new and emerging market entry, conduct baseline threat monitoring and collate security risk information. The role will contribute to functional enhancement projects, support the identification and communication of security events affecting business travellers, and provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises.

Additionally, the GSOC Supervisor will work closely with the GSOC Manager and the GSOC Operator in updating relevant operational processes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

* Support operational planning and readiness through the maintenance and development of security provider networks and the preparation of Concepts of Operations.
* Participate in projects relating to functional enhancements to ensure QatarEnergy maintains best-in-class security assistance capabilities.
* Ensure client awareness of the current security environment in countries across the region of responsibility.
* Travel, as required, to countries within the region to assess the security situation, evaluate local provider capabilities and expand the existing network of security contacts to support clients and operational planning.
* Support new and emerging market entry assessments by conducting baseline threat monitoring and collating relevant security risk information.
* Identify and communicate high-impact, time-sensitive security events to business travellers and internal stakeholders.
* Provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises, escalating requests for assistance to the GSOC Manager, QatarEnergy Senior Leadership and International SOS Assistance Centre, as appropriate.
* Work closely with the GSOC Manager and GSOC Operator to review and update operational processes.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

* Oversee and validate threat monitoring conducted by Operators to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Conduct baseline and enhanced threat assessments, including for new and emerging markets.
* Collate and analyse security risk data to support strategic and operational decision-making.
* Ensure timely escalation of high-impact or time-sensitive threats to stakeholders and leadership.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Supervise the delivery of travel security advice, ensuring consistency with client requirements and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Support the identification and communication of destination-specific risks to business travellers and stakeholders.
* Review incident tracking and reporting to ensure quality, accuracy and completeness.
* Facilitate coordination with internal stakeholders and external assistance providers, where required.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management**

  

* Act as the primary escalation point for Operators during incidents and crises.
* Provide preliminary crisis assessments and security advice to stakeholders.
* Coordinate GSOC response activities and ensure effective information flow during incidents.
* Escalate critical situations to the GSOC Manager, senior leadership and external support entities, as required.
* Support updates and improvements to operational processes and crisis response frameworks

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse operational environments.
* Demonstrated experience in security risk monitoring, intelligence analysis and incident assessment.
* Good understanding of the geopolitical and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Ability to review, validate and enhance intelligence outputs and risk assessments produced by Operators.
* Proficiency in coordinating security assistance tasks, including travel risk management and incident response.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey security risks and advice to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to analyse multiple streams of security, threat and logistical information under time pressure and provide actionable recommendations.
* Familiarity with GSOC operations, escalation protocols and crisis response frameworks.
* Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and relevant operational platforms.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 5–7 years’ experience in security risk management, intelligence analysis or GSOC operations within military, government, NGO or private sector roles.
* Experience in monitoring global threats and providing security risk assessments.
* Experience in supervising or mentoring junior staff in an operational environment.
* Experience in incident management, travel risk management or crisis response support.
* Experience in producing and reviewing reports for internal stakeholders and decision-makers.

### 

### **Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to crisis management and business continuity processes.
* Experience working in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations or similar high-risk environments.
* Experience in client-facing or stakeholder coordination roles.
* Experience supporting new market entry or risk assessments.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or equivalent professional training and experience) in security studies, risk management, international relations, political science or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications in security or risk management (desirable).

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Additional language skills (Arabic, French, etc.) desirable.

Title: Project Engineer - Controls Systems
Description:
### **What You Will Do**

The Project Engineer - Controls will report directly to the Branch Manager and will be based in Qatar. As part of the Controls & Building Automation Systems (BAS) team, you will be responsible for the engineering, design review, project execution, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of Building Management System (BMS) and Integrated Controls projects across multiple client sites.

You will work closely with customers, subcontractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer specifications and company standards. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop advanced technical, project management, and customer engagement skills within a dynamic environment.

### **How You Will Do It**

As a Project Engineer - Controls, you will leverage your technical expertise in BMS and Building Automation Systems to support all phases of project execution, from engineering and design review through commissioning and handover.

You will:

* Execute BMS, HVAC Controls, and Building Automation projects in accordance with project schedules, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Review project specifications, drawings, sequences of operation, and control schematics to ensure compliance with client and consultant requirements.
* Prepare engineering submittals, technical documentation, method statements, and project reports.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to facilitate smooth project execution and timely issue resolution.
* Configure, program, and commission BMS controllers, supervisory systems, field devices, and network integrations.
* Perform functional testing, point-to-point verification, system integration, and site acceptance testing.
* Provide technical support during installation, startup, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, delays, and technical challenges, recommending corrective actions where necessary.
* Ensure compliance with project quality requirements, company procedures, and HSE standards throughout project execution.
* Manage subcontractors and site teams to ensure adherence to project schedules and delivery milestones.
* Assist in project planning, resource allocation, procurement coordination, and material management activities.
* Support project closeout activities, including preparation of as-built documentation, O&M manuals, training, and client handover.
* Prepare progress reports and maintain effective communication with all project stakeholders.

### **What We Look For**

**Required**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or Control Engineering.
* Minimum 5-6 years of experience in the design, engineering, execution, or commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), or Controls projects.
* Proven experience in HVAC controls, chiller plant controls, energy management systems, and building automation applications.
* Strong understanding of control system architectures, field devices, communication protocols, and system integrations including BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, and TCP/IP networking.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, specifications, and technical submittals.
* Experience in system programming, controller configuration, graphics development, and commissioning activities.
* Knowledge of project execution methodologies, risk management, and quality control processes.
* Strong understanding of project documentation, contractual requirements, and client communications.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

* Valid Qatar driving license.
* Strong client-facing, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple stakeholders and project priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on large-scale commercial, healthcare, data center, hospitality, or infrastructure projects within the GCC region.

* A proactive approach to planning, problem-solving and follow-through
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with schedules, agreements and invoices
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Confidence communicating with instructors and students
* A continuous-improvement mindset and interest in making processes more efficient

Operating within a highly collaborative executive environment, the leadership team works collectively to establish priorities, guide decision-making, allocate resources and advance Council-approved objectives. While accountable for their assigned portfolio and serving as the section's lead representative for related Council, committee, media and stakeholder matters, Senior Directors are expected to adopt an enterprise-wide lens, balancing portfolio needs with the broader interests of the division, the City and the communities it serves. Toronto Parks and Recreation delivers services and spaces that enhance the quality of life for millions of residents. Through recreation programs, aquatics, camps, community centres and multi-use facilities, the division provides opportunities for residents across Toronto's diverse neighbourhoods to stay active, connected and engaged.

  

The City of Toronto is seeking a strategic and accomplished leader to serve as Senior Director, Community Recreation.

  

Reporting to the General Manager, Parks and Recreation, the Senior Director provides executive leadership for one of the largest and most diverse community recreation portfolios in Canada. Responsible for recreation programming, facility operations, service access and capacity, operational performance, workforce strategy and quality assurance, this role ensures recreation services remain accessible, equitable and responsive to community needs.

  

Leading through a team of Directors and multidisciplinary professionals, you will oversee the planning, delivery and continuous improvement of recreation programs and services across Toronto. You will ensure programming, facility operations, workforce resources and service delivery standards operate as an integrated system capable of meeting changing community needs and expectations.

  

This role oversees one of the City's most visible public service portfolios, touching the lives of residents every day through recreation programs, camps, aquatic services, community centres and specialized recreation initiatives. Success requires a leader who can balance operational excellence with community impact, ensuring services are delivered efficiently while advancing equity, inclusion, accessibility and participation across Toronto's diverse neighbourhoods.

  

A central focus of the role is fostering a culture of service excellence. Through strong leadership of workforce planning, employee engagement, talent development, performance management and continuous improvement, you will empower teams to deliver exceptional resident experiences and meaningful community outcomes.

  

Success in this role requires exceptional political acuity, relationship management skills and a deep commitment to public service. You will work closely with elected officials, community organizations, residents, user groups and external partners to advance recreation priorities, address emerging issues and help shape the future of recreation services across Toronto.

  

### **What You Bring to the Role:**

* Post-secondary education in Recreation Administration, Public Administration, Community Development or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Extensive senior leadership experience overseeing large-scale recreation, community services, public service delivery or related portfolios within a complex organization.

* Significant experience leading multi-site operations, service delivery systems, workforce management and organizational performance initiatives involving large and diverse workforces.

* Demonstrated expertise in front-line service delivery, service programming, operational planning, customer experience, access and capacity management, performance measurement and continuous improvement.

* Experience managing significant operating budgets and aligning resources, investments and service priorities to achieve strategic and operational objectives.

* Proven ability to lead senior managers, specialized professionals and multidisciplinary teams within a large, diverse and unionized environment.

* Demonstrated success operating in politically sensitive and highly visible environments requiring diplomacy, sound judgment and exceptional stakeholder management capabilities.

* Experience developing productive relationships with community organizations, residents, advocacy groups, government partners and other stakeholders to advance community outcomes.

* Experience presenting strategic recommendations, service initiatives and operational matters to senior leadership teams, elected officials, boards, committees and community stakeholders.

* Familiarity with applicable legislation and regulatory frameworks including occupational health and safety, accessibility, employment and human rights legislation.

**Introduction**

Women’s College Hospital (WCH) is seeking a dynamic, inspiring and visionary medical leader to lead the Department of Medicine and join the medical leadership team. The Department Head will advance innovative models of specialized ambulatory care and strengthen academic, interprofessional, and interorganizational collaboration to improve access, quality and health outcomes for women and gender-diverse people.

The Department Head will report to the Hospital President & CEO through the Vice President, Medical Affairs & System Transformation and Lead Medical Executive. The Department Head is responsible for aligning the Department of Medicine’s clinical, academic and research activities with the Hospital’s strategy, in partnership with the Clinical Director for Specialized Medicine programs. The Department Head works collaboratively with the Temerty Faculty of Medicine, the Toronto Academic Health Science Network (TAHSN), partner hospitals, and the Women’s College Hospital Foundation leadership team.

**The Department of Medicine**

The Department of Medicine at WCH advances the practice and science of medicine through holistic, innovative, and interprofessional approaches to complex health conditions and distinctive models of specialized ambulatory care. The Department advances care for conditions that disproportionately affect women and special populations, including through the specialized Dermatology, Menopause and After Cancer Treatment Transition Clinics.

The Department includes approximately 150 physician faculty members, including clinician teachers, educators, quality and innovation leaders, clinician investigators and clinician scientists. Its Specialized Medicine programs bring together nursing and health discipline professionals as well as clinical and academic administrative staff.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

The Department Head will lead the clinical, academic and resource oversight of the WCH Department of Medicine. More specifically, the Department Head will:

* Provide visionary leadership and operational oversight of the Department to advance the Hospital’s strategic plan and delivery of high-quality, equitable and integrated specialized ambulatory care.
* Build and lead a team of dedicated medical professionals committed to excellence in clinical care, clinical innovation, and continuous quality improvement through physician engagement and collaborative leadership.
* Pursue excellence and represent WCH in academic medicine by advancing the educational, research and scholarly objectives of the Temerty Faculty of Medicine.
* Participate actively in WCH medical leadership.
* Grow existing and build new partnerships to advocate for and advance the goals of WCH beyond its walls.

The successful candidate will be:

* A Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians of Canada or equivalent, eligible for medical licensure in Ontario, and for an academic appointment at the rank of Associate or Full Professor in the Temerty Faculty of Medicine.

* A dynamic, compassionate and people-oriented leader, who demonstrates an empathetic, trusting, and responsive demeanor, with strong mentorship skills and a demonstrated ability to communicate strategically, engage physicians and lead change collaboratively and with accountability.
* An individual experienced in interprofessional models of care and committed to interprofessional education and patient care.
* A person with a strong commitment to social justice, equity and the health of women, gender-diverse people and equity-seeking communities, both locally and globally.
* A person with demonstrated fiscal management and resource stewardship skills, with an emphasis on linking quality outcomes with optimizing costs.

  

**EXPECTATIONS & TERM**

The successful candidate will be an outstanding academic leader and clinician, with proven excellence in managing complex health care environments. Candidates should have a deep commitment to scholarly enterprise, with experience in advancing peer-reviewed research and education in Medicine.

**EMS Education Manager**
=========================

**Posting Number:** #2186

**Position Title:** EMS Education Manager

**Closing Date:** Until Filled

**Location:** Remote, USA

  

The Public Health Institute (PHI) is an independent, nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting health, well-being, and quality of life for people throughout California, across the nation and around the world. As one of the largest and most comprehensive public health organizations in the nation, we are at the forefront of research and innovations to improve the efficacy of public health statewide, nationally, and internationally.

PHI was distinguished as one of the top 50 “Best Non-Profit Organizations to Work For” by the Non-Profit Times in a national search.

  

##### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Bridge Center (Bridge) at the Public Health Institute (PHI) works across the health care system to expand access to low-barrier addiction treatment and sexual and reproductive health care, and to advance health equity. Since 2019, CA Bridge has supported more than 290 hospitals to implement medications for addiction treatment (MAT) in the emergency department (ED) based on the CA Bridge model for 24/7 low-barrier access to evidence-based care. Since then, Bridge has trained teams in 22 states, 56 EDs, and 6 EMS agencies. Collectively, they reach 2,181 providers whose EDs see nearly 2.5 million patient visits a year.

EMS Bridge extends low-barrier MAT to paramedics, bringing EMS-initiated buprenorphine to communities across the country, including in California. The National Expansion Project builds capacity for emergency department-based MAT across the country; the ED Syphilis/HIV/HCV Screening Program supports emergency departments in implementing routine opt-out screening and linkage to care; and Access Bridge increases access to contraception and treatment for pregnancy emergencies from the ED.

##### **POSITION OVERVIEW**

Bridge is hiring an EMS Education Manager to work with our EMS Bridge team. EMS Bridge began in California, which remains home to our largest EMS program and much of our ongoing EMS research and implementation work, and now supports EMS agencies in other states. The EMS Education Manager will lead day-to-day planning, coordination, and delivery of EMS Bridge education, training, and technical assistance for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators, training officers, and agency leaders. Additionally, this role will lead the development and ongoing improvement of EMS Bridge curricula, run EMS Bridge learning collaboratives, and support grant reporting on training and technical assistance activities. Strong project management expertise will be necessary in these tasks. The successful candidate will bring direct experience as a paramedic or EMT and as an EMS educator and will work with a range of team members and external partners to support EMS agencies to offer buprenorphine and connection to ongoing care for people with opioid use disorder.

The full salary range for this position: $79,333 to $115,098 per year. The typical hiring range for this position is from $79,333 (minimum) to $97,216 (midpoint). The starting salary is determined based on the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and budget availability.

Employment Type: Full Time

##### **Important Information**

* This is a regular full-time 1.0 FTE position with a schedule of 40 hours per week.
* This is a fully remote position that requires travel approximately 30% of the work time, to EMS agency sites, trainings, conferences, and partner meetings as requested, including 2-4 All Staff meetings per year in the San Francisco Bay Area.
* The selected candidate will determine their work schedule in collaboration with their supervisor and is expected to be available during core business hours (9:00am – 2:00pm Pacific Time). Some trainings may be scheduled outside core hours, requiring flexible availability, to reach EMS crews on varied shift schedules.
* This position is open to applicants nationwide.
* **To apply, please submit a resume and cover letter detailing your interest in and qualifications for this position.**

##### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following:**

##### **EMS Training & Technical Assistance**

* Under the direction of the National & EMS Program Director, lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of trainings for paramedics and EMTs, in person and virtually, including initial buprenorphine trainings, refreshers, case reviews, and scenario-based sessions.
* Translate strategies and priorities established by senior leadership into actionable training and technical assistance plans, activities, resources, and deliverables.
* Design, coordinate, facilitate, and continuously improve EMS Bridge learning collaboratives and communities of practice for participating EMS agencies. This will include:
  + Developing agendas, learning objectives, session plans, facilitation approaches, and supporting materials for collaborative learning activities.
  + Identifying and coordinating Bridge staff, clinical consultants, field providers, and external presenters to contribute to learning collaborative sessions and other educational programming.
  + Incorporating equity and harm reduction content throughout collaborative programming.
  + Fostering opportunities for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators to learn from one another and build professional connections across agencies and regions.
* Partner with EMS educators, training officers, and agency leaders to build their capacity to teach EMS Bridge content within their own agencies.
* Provide individualized and group mentorship to field providers and EMS educators participating in Bridge programming, drawing on direct experience as a paramedic or EMT and as an EMS educator.
* Assess the training and technical assistance needs of field providers and participating agencies and identify appropriate strategies, resources, and subject matter experts to address those needs.
* Alongside other members of the EMS Bridge team, provide technical assistance related to implementing EMS-initiated buprenorphine, including protocol rollout, field workflows, documentation, patient engagement, crew buy-in and addressing stigma, and handoffs and linkage to care with emergency departments and community treatment programs.
* Identify common themes, challenges, and emerging needs surfaced through trainings, mentorship, and collaborative activities and communicate those findings to Bridge leadership to inform future programming and resource development.
* Identify and disseminate promising practices, tools, resources, and emerging evidence relevant to EMS-initiated buprenorphine and prehospital overdose response.
* Track participation and capture feedback and testimonials from trainings, site visits, and learning collaboratives.
* Represent the Bridge Center’s EMS training and technical assistance work at meetings, trainings, EMS conferences, and other events as requested.

##### **Curriculum & Educational Resource Development**

* Under the direction of the National & EMS Program Director, support development, adaptation, and ongoing improvement of EMS Bridge training curricula and educational resources for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators.
* Develop practical, accessible training materials and resources, including presentations, facilitator guides, case scenarios, skills and simulation activities, job aids, quick-reference tools, and other educational products.
* Collaborate with Bridge clinical experts and other subject matter experts to translate clinical guidance and evidence into practical educational materials for field providers.
* Coordinate subject matter expert review of curricula and resources to ensure materials are accurate, relevant, consistent with Bridge’s approach, and appropriate for EMS audiences.
* Support processes for offering continuing education credit for EMS Bridge trainings, where applicable.
* Incorporate participant feedback, implementation experience, emerging evidence, and changes in the EMS and substance use care landscape into ongoing curriculum and resource improvements.

##### **Project Management & Reporting**

* Manage the day-to-day implementation of assigned EMS training, technical assistance, learning collaborative, and curriculum-development activities from planning through completion.
* Maintain and support the development of project workplans, timelines, milestones, and deliverable trackers to ensure activities remain on schedule.
* Collect and synthesize training attendance, evaluation results, participant feedback, and lessons learned to inform continuous quality improvement.
* Support grant reporting by preparing training and technical assistance data, narratives, and site summaries in line with funder deliverables.
* Collaborate across Bridge teams and projects to identify opportunities to share resources, align programming, reduce duplication, and strengthen the consistency of Bridge training and technical assistance.

Perform other duties as assigned.

##### **QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

##### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Five years’ work experience, including at least one year of experience as a paramedic or EMT, and experience teaching or training others in EMS and/or other clinical settings
* Bachelor’s degree; or high school diploma and an additional four years of relevant work experience, or associate’s degree and an additional two years of relevant work experience.

##### **Other Required Qualifications**

* Knowledge of EMS systems, operations, and culture, and of overdose response and substance use treatment.
* Strong training and presentation skills, and ability to facilitate and engage small and large groups of field providers in dialogue and learning.
* Experience developing training curricula and materials for EMS providers.
* Experience facilitating meetings, learning collaboratives, or communities of practice.
* Understanding of adult learning principles, including scenario-based and simulation learning, and how to embed them in training programs.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Adaptable, flexible, and receptive to feedback.
* Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills.
* Proficiency in Google Suite, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Lived experience with substance use, or with the communities most affected by substance use and overdose, is valued and strengthens this work.

##### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strongly preferred: EMS instructor credential (e.g., state EMS instructor certification or NAEMSE Instructor).
* Preferred: Experience with buprenorphine or other medications for opioid use disorder in EMS or other clinical settings.

**About Tides**
===============

Tides is a nonprofit and philanthropic organization committed to advancing social justice. We work across the social sector to shift power to communities of color and other groups historically denied power.

Centering equity and justice in everything we do, we collaborate in deep partnership with movement leaders, nonprofits, donors, foundations, and corporations to amplify the impact of their work by providing services like fiscal sponsorship, donor advised funds, grant making, and a variety of innovative solutions. Learn more at tides.org.

**About this Role**
===================

Tides seeks a strategic, experienced, and mission-driven leader to serve as its Vice President, People & Culture. The Vice President will be responsible for the culture, systems, and talent that make Tides’ work for its partners and communities possible.

This is a pivotal moment for the organization as Tides responds to external pressures and seeks greater impact through innovation with minimal workforce growth. Meeting these demands will require more of Tides’ people practices: thoughtful organizational design, clear goals and performance expectations, modern, well-integrated systems, and a culture that helps staff adapt to change with confidence. The Vice President will shape how Tides’ staff works, collaborates, and adapts, sustaining the best of Tides’ mission-driven, remote-first culture while strengthening accountability, goal setting, performance management, and organizational effectiveness.

Reporting to the Chief Legal and People Officer, the Vice President will be a trusted advisor to Tides’ senior leaders on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, culture, change management, and JEDI principles and practices. Tides seeks a leader who pairs trust, care, and inclusion with candor and accountability; who can move fluidly between long-term strategy and day-to-day execution; and who will ensure that Tides’ people practices reflect its values and power its mission. The role carries a broad scope and real complexity. The Vice President will lead the people agenda across Tides Network and Tides Center, including an HR team providing support for Tides’ fiscally sponsored projects. They will also serve, in collaboration with the President & CEO and the Executive Team, as an architect and custodian of Tides’ culture, translating the organization’s values into everyday behaviors and keeping a remote-first workforce connected to the mission and to one another.

Reporting to the Chief Legal and People Officer, the Vice President, People & Culture is responsible for shaping Tides’ workplace culture, scaling its organizational infrastructure, and optimizing the end-to-end employee experience across Tides Network, Tides Center, and Tides Foundation, balancing strategy with tactical execution and ensuring that day-to-day people operations are aligned with organization-wide goals.

The Vice President has responsibility for all people functions, including employee and labor relations, organizational development, people operations, talent acquisition, and total rewards. The role also oversees HR business support for Tides Center’s fiscally sponsored projects and Tides’ workforce development, performance management, and staff safety and security. The Vice President will work closely with fellow senior leaders and department heads to ensure alignment between strategy and day-to-day needs and operations.

The Vice President will lead the People Team, with direct reports that include: the Director, Total Rewards & People Operations; the Director, Organization Development and People; and the Director, Tides Center People.

As an executive leader, the Vice President must execute duties and responsibilities while embracing and exhibiting Tides’ core competencies: Leading Self, Leading People, Leading Results.

  

**What you will Do**
====================

**People Strategy**
-------------------

* Serve as a strategic advisor to executive and senior leadership on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, culture, engagement, change, and emerging people priorities.
* Develop and lead Tides’ People & Culture strategy, aligning people priorities with organizational strategy, financial realities, and future workforce needs.
* Help shape and steward Tides’ culture, translating organizational values into leadership practices and day-to-day behaviors.

**Culture & Organizational Effectiveness**
------------------------------------------

* Lead organizational design, change, leadership development, succession, performance management, engagement, and other efforts that strengthen organizational effectiveness and employee experience.
* Build a culture of trust, inclusion, accountability, transparency, continuous learning, healthy feedback, and operational excellence, embedding JEDI principles throughout the organization’s practices and decisions.
* Drive workforce and talent strategy, including workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, and retention, in partnership with Finance, Strategy, Legal and other organizational leaders.

**People Team Leadership**
--------------------------

* Lead and develop a high-performing team, establishing clear priorities, service standards, accountability, and strong partnership across the organization.
* Manage the department budget and oversee performance, talent development, operations, and succession planning.

**People Operations**
---------------------

* Provide strategic direction and oversight for compensation, benefits, job architecture, career pathways, HRIS, payroll partnerships, and other people operations, ensuring programs are equitable, competitive, compliant, and financially sustainable.
* Ensure People Team policies, programs, and practices comply with employment, benefits, and labor laws and the Collective Bargaining Agreement, in partnership with Legal, Risk & Compliance and Finance.
* Champion the thoughtful use of technology and AI to modernize people practices, strengthen the employee experience, and improve efficiency and service delivery.

**Internal Communications & Enterprise Initiatives**
----------------------------------------------------

* Execute internal communications operations in coordination with the Vice President, External Affairs & Strategic Communications, ensuring effective and aligned communication across Tides.
* Lead and coordinate cross-functional initiatives that advance workforce, culture, and broader organizational priorities.

**What you will Bring**
=======================

* 10+ years of directly applicable senior business and HR leadership experience and a relevant bachelor’s degree, or 12+ years of relevant experience, including at least six years in senior leadership roles in-house partnering with executives and leading senior teams;
* Significant experience leading the people function in a complex, matrixed, multi-entity organization, with broad expertise across organizational effectiveness, talent and leadership development, workforce planning, performance management, total rewards, employee and labor relations, talent acquisition, and HR operations;
* Experience aligning labor strategy with business goals including operational excellence and financial sustainability while building a constructive, collaborative labor relationship in support of a healthy organization.
* A track record of leading organizational change and transformation, translating people strategy into measurable outcomes and using data and KPIs to assess impact.
* Strong enterprise, business, and financial acumen, with the ability to connect workforce and people strategies to organizational, operational, and fiscal priorities.
* Experience advising executive leadership and Boards on complex workforce, organizational, and people matters.
* A demonstrated commitment to culture, engagement, inclusion, and belonging, including experience engaging and connecting a remote-first workforce.
* Exceptional judgment, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to navigate complexity, challenge constructively, resolve conflict, build alignment, and make difficult decisions with clarity and empathy.
* An authentic, collaborative, and low-ego leadership style, characterized by high emotional intelligence, accountability, approachability, and comfort operating in a dynamic environment.
* Strong operational and technology orientation, with experience strengthening systems, processes, and HR technology and an openness to emerging tools, including AI; and
* Experience in a substantially unionized environment.

**Preferred qualifications include:**

* Nonprofit or philanthropic experience, particularly experience spanning nonprofit and for-profit environments;
* Advanced degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or a related field; and
* SHRM-SCP, SHRM-CP, or another relevant HR certification.
